items.title: 蘋果「老臣」又少一位？希勒卸兩大要職、退休腳步近了
items.title_en: Apple Veteran Schiller Steps Down from Two Major Roles, Retirement Looms
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)高層世代交替持續加速。在新任執行長特納斯(John Ternus)周二(1日)正式接棒前夕，橫跨賈伯斯(Steve Jobs)與庫克(Tim Cook)時代的資深高層希勒(Phil Schiller)，近日已卸下App Store及產品發表會兩大管理職務，被內部視為朝最終退休邁出的重要一步。
《彭博》引述知情人士報導，現年66歲的希勒仍將留在蘋果，保有「Apple Fellow」頭銜，並向員工表示未來將參與其他尚未公開的專案。蘋果發言人對此拒絕置評。
希勒曾長期擔任蘋果全球行銷資深副總裁，直到2020年卸任。他是蘋果過去數十年最具代表性的高層之一，不僅曾親自發表多款重要產品，也參與iPhone、iPad、iPod及多款Mac的關鍵決策，並與賈伯斯共同主導App Store的誕生。
此次異動正值蘋果權力交接的重要時刻。庫克結束15年執行長生涯後轉任執行董事長，特納斯則正式接掌公司。隨著希勒淡出核心管理職務，特納斯上任後面臨的一大挑戰，就是如何因應資深高層接連離開或退居二線。
近年蘋果已有多名重量級主管異動，包括前營運長威廉斯(Jeff Williams)、前硬體主管里奇奧(Dan Riccio)、前財務長梅斯特里(Luca Maestri)，以及環境與政府事務主管傑克森(Lisa Jackson)等人，均已卸任或轉任較小職務。此外，前法務長與Apple Pay部門主管也預計10月離職。
希勒卸下職務後，App Store將重新劃歸由資深主管庫伊(Eddy Cue)領導的服務事業部。庫伊過去曾負責App Store，直到2015年相關業務才交由希勒與行銷部門管理。此次調整也意味著，庫伊在特納斯時代的影響力將進一步擴大。
App Store日常營運則將由資深主管奧利佛(Carson Oliver)負責，並直接向庫伊報告。原先負責第三方應用程式市集及App分發工具的Thai(Ann Thai)，未來將改向奧利佛報告；Apple Arcade遊戲服務也將納入其管理範圍。
希勒掌管App Store期間，職責遠超過管理這個估計每年創造逾300億美元營收的平台。他長期負責爭議性App的上架與否決策、開發者關係，以及因應各國監管與訴訟調整App Store政策和收入分潤制度，也曾代表蘋果面對《要塞英雄》(Fortnite)開發商Epic Games的長期法律攻防。
另一方面，希勒自2020年卸下行銷主管後仍持續掌管蘋果全球活動及產品發表會業務，如今也將相關職責交給自2023年起擔任其副手的Nola Weinstein。這項交接正值蘋果9月9日舉行秋季發表會前夕，屆時預料將推出首款摺疊iPhone及新一代Apple Watch。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) senior leadership turnover is accelerating. On the eve of new CEO John Ternus officially taking the helm on Tuesday (the 1st), veteran executive Phil Schiller, who spans the Steve Jobs and Tim Cook eras, has recently relinquished his two major management posts overseeing the App Store and product launch events, a move seen internally as a key step toward his ultimate retirement.

Bloomberg, citing sources, reported that the 66‑year‑old Schiller will remain at Apple with the title of “Apple Fellow” and has told staff he will take part in other, as‑yet‑unannounced projects. Apple’s spokesperson declined to comment.

Schiller long served as senior vice president of worldwide marketing until stepping down in 2020. He has been one of Apple’s most iconic executives for decades, personally unveiling numerous flagship products, shaping key decisions for the iPhone, iPad, iPod and various Macs, and co‑leading the creation of the App Store alongside Jobs.

The reshuffle comes at a pivotal moment of power transition at Apple. After 15 years as CEO, Cook is moving to the role of executive chairman, while Ternus formally assumes the chief executive post. With Schiller stepping back from core management, Ternus inherits the challenge of navigating a wave of senior departures and semi‑retirements.

In recent years Apple has seen several heavyweight executives move on, including former COO Jeff Williams, former hardware chief Dan Riccio, former CFO Luca Maestri and environmental and government affairs head Lisa Jackson, all of whom have either left or shifted to smaller roles. Additionally, the former general counsel and head of Apple Pay are slated to depart in October.

Following Schiller’s exit, the App Store will be reassigned to the Services division led by senior executive Eddy Cue. Cue previously oversaw the App Store until 2015, when those responsibilities were transferred to Schiller and the marketing organization. The change signals an expansion of Cue’s influence in the Ternus era.

Day‑to‑day App Store operations will be handled by senior manager Carson Oliver, who will report directly to Cue. Ann Thai, who previously managed the third‑party app marketplace and distribution tools, will now report to Oliver, and Apple Arcade will also fall under his purview.

During Schiller’s tenure overseeing the App Store, his responsibilities far exceeded running a platform that generates more than $30 billion in annual revenue. He handled contentious app approvals, developer relations, and adjustments to App Store policies and revenue‑share structures in response to global regulators and lawsuits, and he represented Apple in the protracted legal battle with Epic Games over Fortnite.

Separately, after stepping down as head of marketing in 2020, Schiller continued to run Apple’s global events and product launches. Those duties are now being handed over to Nola Weinstein, who has served as his deputy since 2023. The handoff comes just before Apple’s September 9 fall event, where the company is expected to unveil its first foldable iPhone and a new generation of Apple Watch.

items.title: 蘋果「庫克時代」正式落幕！最後一封員工信吐露15年真心話
items.title_en: Apple’s “Cook Era” Officially Ends! Final Employee Letter Reveals 15 Years of Heartfelt Reflections
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)執行長庫克(Tim Cook)周一(31日)正式卸下執行長職務，結束長達15年的掌舵生涯。他在任內最後一封致全體員工信中坦言，自己將非常想念這份深愛的工作，但對於把公司交棒給新任執行長特納斯(John Ternus)感到無比安心，並相信後者有能力帶領蘋果邁向下一個階段。
庫克自2011年8月接替蘋果共同創辦人賈伯斯(Steve Jobs)出任執行長，在位期間見證Apple Watch、AirPods等產品問世，同時持續擴大iPhone、iPad與Mac產品線，帶領蘋果締造一段創紀錄的15年執行長任期。
庫克在信中表示，「今天是我擔任蘋果執行長的最後一天」，儘管早已知道這一天終將到來，但真正面對時仍感到難以置信。他感謝員工多年來的付出，並將自己的成就歸功於整個團隊，稱自己從未見過如此傑出的一群人。
回顧蘋果文化，庫克表示，他最自豪的並不是財報能夠呈現的數字，而是公司證明「文化勝過一切」。蘋果員工共同相信，他們打造的產品具有意義，也肩負讓世界變得更好的責任。正是這種信念，讓團隊能彼此激發潛能，實現賈伯斯口中在宇宙留下「一道印記」的願景。
談到卸任心情，庫克坦言，雖然自己並未離開蘋果，但正告別一個深愛的職位，「我將以現在甚至難以想像的方式想念這份工作」，但同時強調，自己對卸任決定已完全釋然。
對於接班人特納斯，庫克則給予高度評價。他表示，很少有人能像特納斯一樣理解打造「改變世界產品」所需要的一切，並形容他聰明、優秀且能力出眾，「我對他的領導再期待不過」。
庫克卸任後並不會離開蘋果，而是轉任執行董事長，未來仍將代表公司處理與全球各國政府的關係，包括美國與中國等重要市場。他也向員工表示，期待未來以新的身分繼續在Apple Park以及世界各地與大家見面。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) CEO Tim Cook formally stepped down from the chief executive role on Monday (the 31st), ending a 15‑year tenure at the helm. In his last letter to all employees, he admitted he will deeply miss the job he loves, but feels completely confident handing the company over to new CEO John Ternus, believing Ternus has the ability to lead Apple into its next phase.

Cook succeeded co‑founder Steve Jobs as CEO in August 2011. During his time in office he oversaw the launch of products such as the Apple Watch and AirPods, while continuously expanding the iPhone, iPad and Mac lines, guiding Apple through a record‑setting 15‑year run as chief executive.

In the letter Cook wrote, “Today is my last day as Apple’s CEO.” Although he had long known the day would come, facing it in reality still felt surreal. He thanked employees for years of dedication and credited his achievements to the entire team, saying he had never seen such an outstanding group of people.

Reflecting on Apple’s culture, Cook said his greatest pride isn’t the numbers on the financial statements but the proof that “culture beats everything.” Apple staff share the belief that the products they create are meaningful and carry a responsibility to make the world better. This conviction, he said, fuels the team’s ability to inspire one another and fulfill the vision Steve Jobs spoke of—leaving a “mark in the universe.”

Speaking about his feelings on stepping down, Cook confessed that although he isn’t leaving Apple, he is saying goodbye to a beloved role. “I will miss this job in ways I can’t even imagine now,” he wrote, while emphasizing that he is fully at peace with his decision to step aside.

Regarding his successor Ternus, Cook gave high praise, noting that few people understand what it takes to build “world‑changing products” as well as Ternus does. He described him as smart, excellent and exceptionally capable, adding, “I could not have higher expectations for his leadership.”

After stepping down as CEO, Cook will not leave Apple; he will become Executive Chairman, continuing to represent the company in dealings with governments worldwide, including key markets such as the United States and China. He told employees he looks forward to meeting them in his new role at Apple Park and around the globe.

items.title: 美媒：中國長鑫存儲已開始試產HBM3E 可能數周內大規模量產
items.title_en: US Media: China's ChangXin Memory Has Started Trial Production of HBM3E, May Reach Mass Production Within Weeks
paras: 美國科技媒體《The Information》週一(8月31日)報導指出，長鑫存儲(CXMT)已經啟動HBM3E記憶體的風險試產工作。該記憶體廠商目前計畫擴大產能，預計到今年底DRAM產能將達到每月35萬片晶圓，未來幾年產能也將持續提高。
目前還不清楚長鑫存儲HBM3E的具體規格，但根據JEDEC規範，HBM3E應採用1024-bit位元寬，單腳速率介於9.2Gbps至 12.4Gbps之間，大多數標準配置的目標速率為9.6Gbps。在9.6Gbps的典型配置下，HBM3E總頻寬可達1.2TB/s，
在採用 8 層堆疊、單層24Gb DRAM晶片的情況下，HBM3E單一堆疊容量為 24GB，採用12層堆疊時容量可達36GB。
考量到長鑫存儲先前已具備從風險試產快速過渡到大規模量產的能力，因此其HBM3E有可能在數週內進入大規模量產階段。
此外，長鑫存儲在晶圓廠無塵室建造速度方面擁有明顯優勢，建造一座晶圓廠無塵室僅需時12個月，其他廠商通常需​​要兩年。
paras_en: The U.S. technology outlet The Information reported on Monday (August 31) that ChangXin Memory (CXMT) has begun risk‑run trial production of its HBM3E memory. The company is planning to expand capacity and expects its DRAM output to reach 350,000 wafers per month by the end of this year, with further increases in the coming years.

Specific details of CXMT’s HBM3E are not yet disclosed, but according to JEDEC specifications the HBM3E should use a 1024‑bit interface with per‑pin data rates ranging from 9.2 Gbps to 12.4 Gbps, most standard configurations targeting 9.6 Gbps. At the typical 9.6 Gbps configuration, the total bandwidth of HBM3E can reach 1.2 TB/s.
With an 8‑stack configuration using 24‑Gb DRAM dies per layer, a single HBM3E stack provides 24 GB of capacity; a 12‑stack configuration can reach 36 GB per stack.
Given CXMT’s proven ability to move quickly from risk‑run trials to large‑scale production, its HBM3E could enter mass production within a few weeks.
CXMT also enjoys a clear advantage in clean‑room construction speed, being able to build a wafer‑fab cleanroom in just 12 months, whereas other manufacturers typically require about two years.

items.title: Fed傳聲筒：升息規則變了！如今不是為何升 而是憑什麼不升
items.title_en: Fed Spokesperson: The Rules for Raising Rates Have Changed! It's No Longer About Why to Raise, but Why Not to Raise
paras: 被市場視為「Fed傳聲筒」的《華爾街日報》(The Wall Street Journal)記者Nick Timiraos日前撰文指出，聯準會(Fed)主席華許上周在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會的演說，不僅降低外界對其抗通膨立場的疑慮，更悄悄改變9月利率決策的門檻：Fed如今可能需要看到足夠疲弱的通膨數據，才有理由繼續按兵不動。
華許演說後，投資人已認為9月升息的可能性高於不升息。巴克萊(Barclays)(BCS-US)及法國興業銀行(Societe Generale)等機構也調整預測，轉而預期Fed將在9月及12月各升息一次。

按兵不動不再是Fed的預設選項

Timiraos指出，華許演說中有兩項觀察明顯偏向升息。首先，他認為目前金融環境很難被稱為具有限制性；其次，6月及7月較溫和的通膨數據，尚未讓他相信潛在物價趨勢已經改善。
利率抑制通膨的主要途徑，是提高借貸成本、降低需求。若借貸條件並不緊縮，通膨又沒有穩定下降，就意味著利率可能還不夠高。
Fed前副主席柯恩(Donald Kohn)認為，在華許演說前，Fed的預設立場是維持利率不變，除非數據提出採取行動的充分理由；如今這項邏輯已經翻轉，Fed可能傾向升息，除非接下來的數據證明沒有必要。
這使9月11日公布的8月消費者物價指數(CPI)，成為9月15日至16日利率會議前的關鍵考驗。華許雖然曾表示，不會過度重視任何單月數據，但若8月通膨再次降溫，便可能與前兩個月構成更明確的改善趨勢，為Fed按兵不動提供依據。
相反地，若8月CPI表現強勁，將削弱通膨正朝2%目標回落的說法。Fed屆時若仍維持利率不變，恐重新引發市場對華許是否有意願採取行動的懷疑。

Fed內部裂痕可能在9月進一步擴大

華許並未預先承諾9月升息。曾任英國央行決策官員的Forbes表示，市場不應把這場演說直接視為政策訊號，因為華許已明確表達，利率決定應在會議中根據當時資訊做出，而不是提前向市場給出答案。
然而，華許在演說中為7月按兵不動所提出的理由，主要是等待供應鏈、投資流向及地緣政治等新資訊，而不是論證目前利率水準已足以壓低通膨。若8月數據沒有明顯轉弱，Fed在9月繼續不升息，華許恐再次面臨難以充分解釋政策立場的困境。
堪薩斯城聯準銀行前總裁Thomas Hoenig警告，華許若無法清楚說明按兵不動的理由，可能損害自身公信力。
Fed決策官員目前也明顯分裂。7月會議已有3名官員反對維持利率不變，另有至少2名當時沒有投票權的官員認為應該升息。鷹派官員擔憂，即使8月通膨數據稍微降溫，關稅、中東衝突及AI投資規模仍會持續推高物價。
另一派官員並不反對最終升息，但認為若每月通膨數據延續6月及7月的降溫趨勢，現在行動可能是錯誤決定。還有部分官員介於兩者之間，原本支持7月按兵不動，9月卻可能轉向升息，使反對維持利率不變的人數超過上次會議。

升息將正面撞上白宮政治壓力

芝加哥聯準銀行總裁古爾斯比(Austan Goolsbee)認為，目前最大的問題是判斷通膨究竟來自短暫供給衝擊，還是需求超過經濟供給能力。若AI投資熱潮造成的過熱現象擴散至整體經濟，Fed便必須以升息回應，政策方向不再模糊。
但供給衝擊也接連出現。關稅並非一次性事件，新措施不斷疊加，部分關稅遭法院推翻後又有其他措施接續上路，使Fed更難判斷物價壓力是否會自然消退。
此外，9月升息距離11月初期中選舉僅剩數周，可能打亂川普政府宣稱通膨已受控制的政治訊息。川普近來雖未像過去攻擊前主席鮑爾那樣公開施壓華許，但曾暗示華許本人傾向維持利率不變，是其他決策官員推動升息。
Hoenig坦言，認為政治壓力不會影響央行官員並不切實際，即使決策者努力將政治因素排除在外，壓力仍始終存在。
Timiraos認為，華許的演說證明他願意回應外界批評。他重新確認Fed的2%通膨目標，也不再重提AI將壓低物價、允許Fed更快降息的舊論點。如今，真正考驗將落在9月：若CPI沒有明顯降溫，華許就必須在升息引發白宮不滿，與按兵不動損害Fed公信力之間做出選擇。
paras_en: The Wall Street Journal reporter Nick Timiraos, often seen as the Fed's spokesperson, wrote that Fed Chair Jerome Powell's speech at the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Meeting last week not only reduced external doubts about his anti‑inflation stance, but also quietly shifted the threshold for the September rate decision: the Fed may now need to see sufficiently weak inflation data before it has a reason to hold steady.

After Powell's speech, investors have come to believe that a September rate hike is more likely than a hold. Institutions such as Barclays (BCS‑US) and Societe Generale have also revised their forecasts, now expecting the Fed to raise rates once in September and once in December.

Holding steady is no longer the Fed's default option. Timiraos notes that Powell's remarks contained two observations that clearly leaned toward a hike. First, he said the current financial environment is hard to describe as restrictive; second, the milder inflation data in June and July have not convinced him that underlying price trends have improved.

The main way interest rates curb inflation is by raising borrowing costs and dampening demand. If borrowing conditions are not tightening and inflation is not steadily falling, it suggests rates may still not be high enough.

Former Fed Vice‑Chair Donald Kohn said that before Powell's speech the Fed's default stance was to keep rates unchanged unless the data provided a compelling reason to act; that logic has now flipped, and the Fed may lean toward a hike unless upcoming data show no need for it.

This makes the August CPI, released on September 11, a crucial test before the September 15‑16 policy meeting. Powell has said he will not over‑emphasize any single month’s data, but if August inflation cools again it could form a clearer improvement trend with the previous two months, giving the Fed a basis to hold steady.

Conversely, a strong August CPI would weaken the case that inflation is moving back toward the 2% target. If the Fed then kept rates unchanged, it could revive market doubts about Powell’s willingness to act.

Internal Fed divisions could widen further in September. Powell did not pre‑commit to a September hike. Former Bank of England policymaker Forbes warned markets should not treat the speech as a policy signal, because Powell made clear that rate decisions will be made at the meeting based on the information then available, not by giving the market an advance answer.

However, the reason Powell gave for holding steady in July was mainly to await new information on supply chains, investment flows and geopolitics, not to argue that current rates were sufficient to suppress inflation. If August data do not show a clear weakening, a continued hold in September could again leave Powell struggling to fully explain the policy stance.
Former Kansas City Fed President Thomas Hoenig warned that if Powell cannot clearly articulate the rationale for holding steady, his credibility could be damaged.

Fed policymakers are now visibly split. At the July meeting three officials voted against keeping rates unchanged, and at least two officials without voting rights thought a hike was warranted. Hawkish members worry that even if August inflation eases slightly, tariffs, Middle‑East conflicts and the scale of AI investment will continue to push prices up.

The other camp does not oppose a eventual hike but believes that if monthly inflation data continue the cooling seen in June and July, acting now could be a mistake. Some officials sit in the middle, having supported the July hold but now possibly shifting to a hike in September, which would push the number of opponents of a hold above that at the last meeting.

A rate hike would run head‑on into political pressure from the White House. Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee says the biggest question now is whether inflation stems from a temporary supply shock or from demand outpacing economic capacity. If the AI investment boom overheats the broader economy, the Fed would have to respond with hikes, ending any ambiguity in policy direction.

But supply‑side shocks keep arriving. Tariffs are not a one‑off; new measures keep stacking, and some tariffs overturned by courts are replaced by other actions, making it harder for the Fed to judge whether price pressures will naturally recede.

Moreover, a September hike would come just weeks before the early‑November midterm elections, potentially disrupting the Trump administration’s political narrative that inflation is under control. While Trump has not recently pressured Powell as he did former Chair Powell, he has hinted that Powell himself leans toward holding rates steady while other officials push for a hike.
Hoenig admits that believing political pressure will not affect central‑bank officials is unrealistic; even if policymakers try to insulate decisions from politics, the pressure remains ever present.

Timiraos concludes that Powell’s speech shows he is willing to respond to external criticism. He reaffirmed the Fed’s 2% inflation goal and dropped the old talking point that AI would lower prices and allow faster rate cuts. The real test now lies in September: if CPI does not cool noticeably, Powell will have to choose between a hike that angers the White House and holding steady at the risk of damaging the Fed’s credibility.

paras: 材料-KY(4763-TW)營運動能正持續回復中，2026年上半年稅後純益18.31億元，每股純益1.85元。同時，材料-KY對2025年下半年股息3.05元，訂9月16除息交易，由於材料-KY對2025年上半年並未配發股利，等於在2025年每股純益6.1元，全年配發3.05元股息，盈餘配發率50%。
依今天材料-KY收盤價46.3元計算，材料-KY對去年股息3.05元的現金殖利率爲6.58%。
材料-KY在2026 年 7 月營收站穩 10 億元大關，達 10.59 億元，爲 2026 年單月新高，月增 4.5%，年增 32.05%，展現營運動能穩步回升；2026 年 1-7 月營收 66.13 億元，則年減 24.98%。公司表示，將持續強化成本控管、提升營運效率，並調整產品與市場布局，積極因應市場變化。
材料-KY2026年第二季營收27.43億元 ，毛利率40.89%，季減14.69個百分點，年減17.34個百分點，稅後純益7.17億元，季減35.73%，年減57.92%，每股純益0.72元。材料-KY2026年上半年營收55.54億元，毛利率48.06%，年減10.28個百分點，2026年上半年稅後純益18.31億元，年減5.95%，每股純益1.85元。
paras_en: Materials-KY (4763‑TW) is seeing its operating momentum steadily recover. For the first half of 2026, after‑tax net profit reached NT$1.831 billion, or NT$1.85 per share. The company announced a NT$3.05 dividend for the second half of 2025, with the ex‑dividend date set for September 16. Because no dividend is paid for the first half of 2025, earnings per share for 2025 will be NT$6.10, and the full‑year dividend of NT$3.05 represents a payout ratio of 50%.
Based on the closing price of NT$46.3 today, the cash dividend yield for the NT$3.05 dividend paid last year is 6.58%.

In July 2026, Materials‑KY’s revenue stabilized above the NT$1 billion mark, reaching NT$1.059 billion – a new monthly high for 2026 – up 4.5% month‑over‑month and 32.05% year‑over‑year, indicating a steady rebound in operating momentum. Revenue for January‑July 2026 totaled NT$6.613 billion, down 24.98% year‑over‑year. The company said it will continue to strengthen cost control, improve operational efficiency, and adjust its product and market positioning to actively respond to market changes.

Materials‑KY reported second‑quarter 2026 revenue of NT$2.743 billion, with a gross margin of 40.89%, down 14.69 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and 17.34 points year‑over‑year. After‑tax net profit was NT$717 million, down 35.73% quarter‑over‑quarter and 57.92% year‑over‑year, yielding earnings per share of NT$0.72. For the first half of 2026, revenue was NT$5.554 billion, gross margin 48.06% (down 10.28 points year‑over‑year), and after‑tax net profit NT$1.831 billion, down 5.95% year‑over‑year, with earnings per share of NT$1.85.

items.title: 假色情App竟會偷偷轉走存款！Meta急下架數十則詐騙廣告
items.title_en: Meta Quickly Removes Dozens of Fraud Ads After Scam Apps Pretend to Be Porn Sites and Steal Deposits
paras: Meta(META-US)周一(31日)下架數十則臉書(Facebook)與Instagram廣告。印度政府發現，詐騙集團利用帶有露骨色情內容的廣告，誘騙用戶下載惡意安卓(Android)應用程式，藉此竊取網路銀行登入資料，甚至直接轉走帳戶資金。
印度政府指出，這些廣告以「Night Play」、「Kyss」等名稱在臉書及Instagram投放，點擊後會將用戶導向網路釣魚網站。近期當局觀察到，偽裝成色情App的惡意安卓應用程式明顯增加，並被用於發動金融詐騙。
《路透》在印度政府周一發布警示後，仍發現至少39則相關廣告處於刊登狀態，其中許多使用露骨影片縮圖吸引用戶點擊。《路透》向Meta提出詢問並通報後，Meta隨即移除所有相關廣告，但未回應置評要求。
其中一則廣告會將用戶導向宣稱提供數百部色情影片及全天候內容的網站。用戶若要觀看，必須繞過官方應用程式商店，直接下載名為「Movexa.apk」的安裝檔。
印度政府警告，這類惡意App可能在用戶不知情的情況下，存取手機內儲存的資訊、攔截一次性密碼(OTP)與銀行個人識別碼(PIN)，並從銀行帳戶轉走資金。
印度2025年因網路詐騙蒙受的損失接近24億美元。隨著數位支付在當地快速普及，詐騙集團也日益將印度用戶列為主要目標。這也是印度政府近幾周第二度對大型科技平台上的金融詐騙提出警告。印度先前要求Google關閉Firebase平台上的數百個帳戶，原因是犯罪分子利用相關服務冒充大型銀行。
Meta政策明文禁止廣告包含成人裸露及性行為內容，也禁止利用欺騙或誤導方式騙取用戶金錢。不過，《路透》去年曾報導，Meta內部一度估計，詐騙及違禁商品廣告可能貢獻公司2024年約10%營收，相當於約160億美元；Meta則表示，公司持續打擊相關廣告。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) removed dozens of Facebook and Instagram ads on Monday (the 31st). The Indian government discovered that fraud groups were using ads with explicit pornographic content to lure users into downloading malicious Android apps, which then stole online banking login credentials and even transferred funds directly from accounts.

The Indian government said the ads were run on Facebook and Instagram under names such as “Night Play” and “Kyss,” and clicking them directed users to phishing sites. Authorities have recently observed a sharp rise in malicious Android apps masquerading as porn apps, which are being used to carry out financial scams.

After the Indian government issued a warning on Monday, Reuters still found at least 39 of the related ads still live, many using graphic video thumbnails to attract clicks. Reuters queried Meta and reported the ads; Meta promptly removed all of them but did not respond to requests for comment.

One of the ads directed users to a site that claimed to offer hundreds of porn videos and 24‑hour content. To watch, users had to bypass official app stores and download an installer called “Movexa.apk.”

The Indian government warned that such malicious apps can, without the user’s knowledge, access information stored on the phone, intercept one‑time passwords (OTPs) and bank PINs, and transfer money out of bank accounts.

India suffered nearly $2.4 billion in losses from online scams in 2025. As digital payments spread rapidly in the country, fraudsters are increasingly targeting Indian users. This is the second warning in weeks to large tech platforms about financial fraud. India previously asked Google to shut down hundreds of accounts on its Firebase platform after criminals used the service to impersonate major banks.

Meta’s policy explicitly bans ads that contain adult nudity or sexual activity and prohibits deceptive practices that trick users into giving money. However, Reuters reported last year that Meta internally estimated fraud and prohibited‑goods ads could have contributed about 10% of the company’s 2024 revenue—roughly $16 billion—and Meta says it continues to combat such ads.

items.title: OpenAI找到新金雞母！ChatGPT廣告一年可望進帳10億美元
items.title_en: OpenAI Finds New Money-Maker! ChatGPT Ads Could Bring in $1 Billion in a Year
paras: OpenAI周一(31日)宣布，旗下廣告業務的年化營收運行率已達10億美元。這項業務推出僅約200天便跨越重要里程碑，公司將其視為商業模式日益多元化的證明。
所謂年化營收運行率，是依目前營收速度推算未來12個月可能達到的規模，並不代表OpenAI已實際取得10億美元廣告收入。
OpenAI正為外界預期規模龐大的首次公開募股(IPO)做準備，同時面臨向投資人證明其8,520億美元估值合理性的壓力。公司表示，廣告將與企業服務、消費者訂閱及按使用量計費的應用程式介面(API)，共同構成主要營收來源。
OpenAI今年2月開始在美國測試ChatGPT廣告，相關決定雖早在市場預期之中，仍引發不小爭議。數位廣告長期是Google(GOOGL-US)與Meta(META-US)等科技巨頭的重要獲利來源，但OpenAI的主要競爭對手Anthropic曾在首支超級盃廣告中，直接嘲諷OpenAI將廣告導入聊天機器人的做法。
目前ChatGPT Ads已進入逾40個國家，OpenAI周一進一步在印度、歐洲、中東及北非推出廣告主自助投放服務。ChatGPT廣告主要向免費版及Go方案用戶顯示，這兩類用戶占平台每周10億名活躍用戶的絕大多數。
面對外界對使用體驗及隱私的疑慮，OpenAI強調，所有廣告都會清楚標示，不會影響ChatGPT生成的回答，廣告主也無法存取用戶的私人對話內容。
OpenAI表示，下一階段將把ChatGPT Ads推向更多市場，並增加廣告格式、行銷目標、購買方式及成效衡量工具，同時探索讓企業以更自然的方式在ChatGPT中與消費者互動。
paras_en: OpenAI announced on Monday (31st) that the annualized revenue run rate of its advertising business has reached $1 billion. The service, launched just about 200 days ago, has crossed a key milestone, and the company views it as proof of its increasingly diversified business model.

The so‑called annualized revenue run rate is a projection of the scale that could be achieved over the next 12 months based on current revenue velocity, and does not mean that OpenAI has actually earned $1 billion in advertising revenue yet.

OpenAI is preparing for a highly anticipated initial public offering (IPO) while also facing pressure to justify its $852 billion valuation to investors. The company said that advertising will, alongside enterprise services, consumer subscriptions, and usage‑based API billing, form its core revenue streams.

OpenAI began testing ChatGPT ads in the United States in February this year. Although the decision was expected, it sparked significant controversy. Digital advertising has long been a major profit source for tech giants such as Google (GOOGL‑US) and Meta (META‑US), but OpenAI’s main competitor Anthropic mocked the move in its first Super Bowl ad by directly ridiculing the idea of embedding ads in a chatbot.

ChatGPT Ads are now available in more than 40 countries, and on Monday OpenAI expanded self‑serve advertising for advertisers to India, Europe, the Middle East, and North Africa. The ads appear mainly to free‑tier and Go‑plan users, who make up the vast majority of the platform’s 1 billion weekly active users.

In response to concerns about user experience and privacy, OpenAI emphasized that all ads will be clearly labeled, will not affect the answers generated by ChatGPT, and that advertisers cannot access users’ private conversation content.

OpenAI said that the next phase will roll out ChatGPT Ads to more markets, add new ad formats, marketing objectives, purchasing methods, and performance measurement tools, while exploring ways for businesses to interact with consumers in a more natural manner within ChatGPT.

items.title: 油價降不下來！美伊戰火恐讓明年續守每桶80美元
items.title_en: Oil Prices Won’t Drop! US-Iran War May Keep Prices Above $80 a Barrel Next Year
paras: 《路透》最新調查顯示，儘管中國需求疲弱限制油價漲勢，但美伊戰爭引發的中東供應及航運風險持續，使分析師大致維持2026年國際油價每桶高於80美元的預測。
《路透》8月訪調31名經濟學家與分析師，預估2026年布蘭特原油均價為每桶85.08美元，美國西德州中級原油(WTI)均價則為80.20美元，與7月預估的85.22美元及80.14美元相差不大。
星展銀行(DBS)能源研究主管Suvro Sarkar表示，中國仍是油價面臨的最大下行風險。只要油價維持在每桶80美元以上，中國進口需求可能持續低迷，煉油商也只有在油價降至更具吸引力的水準後，才有較強意願補充庫存。
中國6月原油進口量降至近10年低點，7月進口量也較去年同期大減24.3%。受此影響，受訪分析師預估，2026年全球石油需求可能每日萎縮100萬至160萬桶。
不過，中東供應中斷風險持續為油價提供支撐。美伊戰爭自2月底爆發後，攻擊範圍擴大至波斯灣地區的能源與航運設施，導致包括荷姆茲海峽在內的中東重要水道船舶流量大幅減少。
8月恢復荷姆茲海峽航運的談判進展有限。美軍周日攻擊伊朗拉拉克島(Larak Island)兩座發射器，成為7月底以來已知的首次對伊朗攻擊。伊朗媒體引述革命衛隊說法報導，伊朗隨後攻擊美國位於約旦的兩處空軍基地。
供應疑慮推動布蘭特原油近期主要在每桶接近90美元至95美元附近交易。伊朗與阿曼仍在協商荷姆茲海峽協議的執行細節，內容包括共同管理水道及分享相關收入。
Price Futures Group資深分析師Phil Flynn表示，交易員已不再押注波斯灣石油出口即將全面崩潰，但同樣不認為航運能夠迅速恢復正常。《路透》調查顯示，分析師預估2026年全球石油市場仍將處於供不應求，供給缺口估計每日介於165萬至350萬桶。
各機構對需求展望則存在明顯分歧。國際能源署(IEA)預估2026年全球石油需求將每日減少160萬桶，石油輸出國組織(OPEC)則預測每日增加58萬桶，但已較先前估值下修20萬桶。
OPEC與俄羅斯等產油盟國組成的OPEC+已宣布，9月每日增產18.8萬桶，完成撤回2023年以來約165萬桶自願減產措施的計畫。然而，美伊戰爭延續半年後，中東供應中斷對市場的影響已蓋過OPEC+增產決策。中國進口下滑雖抑制漲幅，但只要航運尚未恢復正常，油價仍可望守在每桶80美元以上。
paras_en: Reuters’ latest survey shows that despite weak Chinese demand curbing oil price rises, the Middle East supply and shipping risks triggered by the US‑Iran war continue to keep analysts broadly maintaining a forecast of international oil prices above $80 a barrel in 2026.

Reuters’ August survey of 31 economists and analysts estimates the 2026 Brent crude average at $85.08 a barrel, and the US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) average at $80.20 a barrel, very close to the July estimates of $85.22 and $80.14 respectively.

Suvro Sarkar, head of energy research at DBS, says China remains the biggest downside risk to oil prices. As long as prices stay above $80 a barrel, Chinese import demand may remain weak, and refiners will only be more willing to replenish inventories if prices fall to a more attractive level.

Chinese crude oil imports fell to a near‑10‑year low in June, and July imports were down 24.3% year‑on‑year. Analysts therefore project global oil demand could shrink by 1.0 to 1.6 million barrels per day in 2026.

However, the risk of Middle East supply disruptions continues to support oil prices. Since the US‑Iran war erupted at the end of February, attacks have expanded to energy and shipping facilities in the Persian Gulf, sharply reducing shipping traffic through key Middle Eastern waterways, including the Hormuz Strait.

Negotiations to restore shipping through the Hormuz Strait in August have made limited progress. On Sunday, US forces attacked two launchers on Iran’s Larak Island, the first known attack on Iran since the end of July. Iranian media, citing the Revolutionary Guard, reported that Iran subsequently struck two US air bases in Jordan.

Supply concerns have pushed Brent crude to trade recently near $90 to $95 a barrel. Iran and Oman are still negotiating the details of a Hormuz Strait agreement, which would involve joint management of the waterway and sharing of related revenues.

Phil Flynn, a senior analyst at Price Futures Group, says traders no longer bet on a total collapse of Persian Gulf oil exports, but he also does not believe shipping will quickly return to normal. Reuters’ survey shows analysts expect the global oil market to remain in supply‑shortage in 2026, with a daily supply gap estimated at 1.65 to 3.5 million barrels.

There is a clear split in demand outlooks among institutions. The International Energy Agency (IEA) projects a daily decline of 1.6 million barrels in global oil demand in 2026, while the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) forecasts a daily increase of 580,000 barrels, having cut its previous estimate by 200,000 barrels.

OPEC and other oil‑producing allies in OPEC+ have announced a daily increase of 188,000 barrels in September, completing the withdrawal of about 1.65 million barrels of voluntary cuts since 2023. However, after six months of the US‑Iran war, the impact of Middle East supply disruptions has outweighed OPEC+’s production decisions. Chinese import declines may curb price rises, but as long as shipping has not returned to normal, oil prices are likely to stay above $80 a barrel.

items.title: 輝達35億美元入股聯發科NVLink開放客製AI晶片新戰局
items.title_en: Nvidia Invests $3.5 Billion in MediaTek, Opening a New Era of Custom AI Chips with NVLink
paras: 2026年08月31日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 輝達宣布以35億美元認購聯發科可轉換公司債，雙方合作由消費性晶片延伸至AI基礎設施、邊緣運算與智慧車三大領域。聯發科並將取得NVLink Fusion平台技術，得以替超大規模資料中心、雲端服務商及前沿模型業者設計客製化處理器，意味AI晶片競爭正從單一GPU，轉向整櫃系統與客製XPU共存的新架構。
這筆投資的關鍵，不只在資金規模，而是輝達把高速互連與機櫃級平台向合作夥伴開放。聯發科可將自家SoC與客製運算能力接入輝達AI工廠及機櫃級系統，縮短客戶開發專用晶片的時程，也讓雲端業者在維持CUDA與NVLink生態相容性的同時，增加針對特定模型、功耗與成本優化的空間。
對輝達而言，與聯發科結盟有助守住AI資料中心的系統主導權。當大型雲端客戶加速自研晶片，單靠通用GPU的議價能力可能面臨壓力；透過NVLink Fusion串接第三方CPU與XPU，輝達可把競爭焦點由晶片本身拉高至網路、互連、軟體與整機櫃標準，擴大平台黏著度。
雙方也將延續多代晶片合作，並開發AI驅動的軟體定義車輛平台。聯發科因此由手機與邊緣裝置供應商，進一步切入資料中心客製運算與實體AI；若合作落地，台灣IC設計業在全球AI供應鏈的角色，可能由零組件供應提升為平台級共同設計者，並重塑ASIC、GPU與雲端自研晶片之間的競爭邊界。

paras_en: August 31, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Nvidia announced a $3.5 billion subscription for MediaTek convertible bonds, expanding cooperation from consumer chips to three major areas: AI infrastructure, edge computing and intelligent vehicles. MediaTek will also acquire NVLink Fusion platform technology, enabling it to design custom processors for hyperscale data centers, cloud service providers and frontier model developers, signalling that AI‑chip competition is shifting from a single GPU to a new architecture that combines full‑rack systems with custom XPU coexistence.

The significance of the investment lies not only in its size but in Nvidia opening its high‑speed interconnect and rack‑level platform to a partner. MediaTek can plug its own SoCs and custom compute capabilities into Nvidia’s AI factory and rack‑scale systems, shortening customers’ development cycles for dedicated chips and giving cloud operators the ability to retain CUDA and NVLink ecosystem compatibility while gaining flexibility to optimise for specific models, power and cost.

For Nvidia, the alliance with MediaTek helps safeguard its system leadership in AI data centers. As large cloud customers accelerate in‑house chip development, reliance on generic GPUs could weaken bargaining power; by linking third‑party CPUs and XPUs through NVLink Fusion, Nvidia can shift the competitive focus from the chip itself to networking, interconnect, software and full‑rack standards, increasing platform stickiness.

The two companies will continue multi‑generation chip collaboration and develop an AI‑driven software‑defined vehicle platform. MediaTek will thus move from being a smartphone and edge‑device supplier to entering custom compute for data centers and physical AI. If the partnership materialises, Taiwan’s IC design industry could rise from a component supplier to a platform‑level co‑designer in the global AI supply chain, reshaping the competitive boundaries among ASICs, GPUs and cloud‑native chips.
