items.title: 聯發科搶XPU、輝達賣整套 黃仁勳首揭AI兩強結盟盤算
items.title_en: MediaTek Pursues XPU, NVIDIA Sells Full Suite; Jensen Huang First Reveals AI Duo Alliance Plans
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)今(31)日宣布斥資35億美元認購聯發科(2454-TW)海外第一次無擔保轉換公司債(ECB)，雙方合作正式從既有邊緣AI與PC晶片，全面擴大至客製化XPU與AI Factory。輝達執行長黃仁勳與聯發科執行長蔡力行受訪時直言，未來只要聯發科拿下XPU專案，就有機會同步帶動輝達NVLink、交換器、CPU與機櫃級AI基礎建設銷售，「當聯發科贏，我們就有機會賣更多；當我們贏，聯發科也有機會賣更多」。
黃仁勳指出，輝達與聯發科原本就有深厚合作，早期雙方將NVIDIA NVLink chip-to-chip介面整合至聯發科SoC，使聯發科處理器可以直接與NVIDIA GPU連接，並催生DGX Spark等產品。接下來，雙方合作將進一步延伸至多個世代，涵蓋DGX Spark、RTX Spark，以及未來AI PC相關產品。
相較既有合作，此次更具戰略意義的部分在於AI資料中心。黃仁勳表示，聯發科在客製化XPU領域已取得相當成果，未來透過NVLink Fusion，可將聯發科設計的XPU直接接入NVIDIA完整AI Factory架構。
也就是說，聯發科未來拿下超大規模雲端業者、雲端服務供應商或AI模型開發商的客製化XPU訂單後，客戶不必再自行建置整套周邊系統，而可直接搭配NVIDIA既有的scale-up、scale-out網路、Spectrum-X交換器、CPU與機櫃級架構，大幅縮短開發時間。
黃仁勳強調，現在的AI Factory早已不只是GPU，而是一套完整系統還需要多種交換器、網路、CPU與其他晶片。他透露，目前一座AI Factory內約涉及7種不同類型的NVIDIA晶片，而XPU僅會取代其中一部分，因此即使客戶導入客製化ASIC，NVIDIA仍可透過其他基礎建設產品持續參與。
他也直言，NVIDIA並不畏懼XPU或ASIC快速崛起，因為XPU不是要進入市場，而是早就在市場裡。相較XPU屬於專用晶片，NVIDIA GPU定位為通用加速器，可涵蓋資料處理、AI訓練、後訓練與Agentic AI推論等完整工作負載。
因此，面對大型雲端業者持續投入自研ASIC，NVIDIA的策略不是封閉生態系，而是主動透過NVLink Fusion讓這些XPU更容易接入NVIDIA平台。黃仁勳直言，輝達並沒有受到威脅，反而歡迎它，只要客戶仍採用NVIDIA整套AI基礎建設，即使部分運算改用客製化XPU，NVIDIA仍能分享整體AI Factory成長商機。
蔡力行則表示，AI運算市場橫跨超大規模雲端業者自研ASIC、企業資料中心，一直到桌上型AI超級電腦，不同客戶都有不同程度的客製化需求。聯發科的XPU設計能力搭配NVIDIA NVLink Fusion，可以讓客戶更快推出差異化產品，尤其在AI快速演進下，縮短time-to-market已成為最重要的競爭力之一。
針對此次合作是否有助聯發科AI ASIC業務進一步加速，蔡力行也明確表示，當然預期會如此。不過，由於目前才開始把NVIDIA最新一代NVLink技術整合進相關機櫃與系統平台，實際效益仍需要一些時間逐步發酵。
蔡力行更透露，目前聯發科已與部分潛在客戶展開接洽，其中部分專案甚至將與NVIDIA採取共同Go-to-Market模式。此次NVIDIA直接投資聯發科，也可望進一步提升客戶對雙方合作關係的信心，讓客戶更願意採用聯發科XPU搭配NVLink Fusion的整體方案。
黃仁勳指出，這次35億美元投資也代表雙方關係已從單純技術合作，升級成更大規模的工程與商業整合，聯發科也是輝達目前最大型的合作夥伴關係之一。他也透露，自己與蔡力行已認識25年，雙方關係建立在長期信任之上，而這次合作更不是一至兩年的短期專案，而是長達十年的產品路線圖，輝達也希望透過35億美元投資，展現對聯發科與雙方合作前景的高度信心。
另一方面，蔡力行也指出，聯發科此次募資資金將用於多項用途，除了強化全球供應鏈外，也將持續加碼晶片設計、ASIC、互連IP以及先進封裝能力，藉此支援後續更大型的AI專案。
他坦言，目前聯發科最大的挑戰仍是供應鏈，包括HBM、載板等環節都存在壓力，不過台灣位處全球AI基礎建設供應鏈核心，加上未來可進一步整合NVIDIA供應鏈資源，將有助提升聯發科承接大型AI ASIC專案的能力。
黃仁勳也補充，透過此次合作，NVIDIA的networking生態系將成為聯發科供應鏈的一部分，而聯發科的XPU能力也將納入NVIDIA生態系，等於雙方彼此擴大供應鏈與產品版圖。
值得注意的是，黃仁勳此次也透露，NVIDIA下一代HBM將採用客製化HBM架構，HBM stack底部將使用NVIDIA自行設計的custom base layer，相關技術已開放給NVLink Fusion合作夥伴，包括聯發科與亞馬遜(Amazon)(AMZN-US)，未來可與客製化XPU共同整合進先進封裝。
這也顯示，聯發科與NVIDIA的合作已不只是晶片對晶片的互連，而是一路延伸至XPU、HBM、先進封裝、Networking與機櫃級AI Factory。對聯發科而言，可藉此從單純ASIC設計角色，進一步切入完整AI系統平台；對NVIDIA而言，則可在客戶自研ASIC趨勢持續升溫下，藉由NVLink Fusion把更多客製化晶片納入自身生態系，持續擴大每座AI Factory中的內容價值。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) announced today (the 31st) that it will invest $3.5 billion to subscribe to MediaTek's (2454-TW) first overseas unsecured convertible bond (ECB), formalizing a partnership that expands from existing edge AI and PC chips to custom XPU and AI Factory solutions. NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang and MediaTek CEO Cai Lixing said that whenever MediaTek wins an XPU project, it could also drive sales of NVIDIA NVLink, switches, CPUs and rack‑level AI infrastructure, adding, "When MediaTek wins, we have the chance to sell more; when we win, MediaTek also has the chance to sell more."

Huang noted that NVIDIA and MediaTek already have deep cooperation; early on the two integrated NVIDIA’s NVLink chip‑to‑chip interface into MediaTek SoCs, allowing MediaTek processors to connect directly to NVIDIA GPUs and spawning products such as DGX Spark. Going forward the collaboration will extend across multiple generations, covering DGX Spark, RTX Spark and future AI‑PC related products.

Compared with existing cooperation, the more strategic element this time lies in AI data centers. Huang said MediaTek has achieved significant results in custom XPU, and through NVLink Fusion the XPU designed by MediaTek can be plugged directly into NVIDIA’s full AI Factory architecture.

In other words, once MediaTek secures large‑scale cloud operators, cloud service providers or AI model developers for custom XPU orders, customers will no longer need to build an entire surrounding system themselves; they can simply pair the XPU with NVIDIA’s existing scale‑up, scale‑out networking, Spectrum‑X switches, CPUs and rack‑level architectures, dramatically shortening development time.

Huang emphasized that today’s AI Factory is no longer just GPUs but a complete system that requires many switches, networks, CPUs and other chips. He disclosed that a typical AI Factory involves about seven different types of NVIDIA chips, and XPU will replace only a portion of them, so even if customers adopt custom ASICs, NVIDIA can still participate through its other infrastructure products.

He also stated that NVIDIA is not afraid of the rapid rise of XPU or ASIC, because XPU is not a new market entrant—it has already been in the market. While XPU is a specialized chip, NVIDIA GPUs are positioned as general‑purpose accelerators that can handle data processing, AI training, post‑training and agentic AI inference workloads in full.

Therefore, faced with large cloud providers investing in self‑developed ASICs, NVIDIA’s strategy is not to close the ecosystem but to proactively make those XPUs easier to integrate via NVLink Fusion. Huang said NVIDIA does not feel threatened; on the contrary, it welcomes XPU, because as long as customers continue to use NVIDIA’s full AI infrastructure, even if part of the compute shifts to custom XPU, NVIDIA can still share the overall AI Factory growth opportunity.

Cai said the AI compute market spans from self‑developed ASICs of hyperscale cloud providers, to enterprise data centers, all the way to desktop AI supercomputers, and each customer has varying degrees of customization needs. MediaTek’s XPU design capability combined with NVIDIA NVLink Fusion enables customers to launch differentiated products faster, and in the rapidly evolving AI landscape, shortening time‑to‑market has become one of the most critical competitive advantages.

When asked whether the partnership will accelerate MediaTek’s AI ASIC business, Cai answered unequivocally that it will. However, because the integration of NVIDIA’s latest‑generation NVLink into relevant racks and system platforms has only just begun, the tangible benefits will take some time to mature.

Cai also revealed that MediaTek is already in talks with several potential customers, and some projects may adopt a joint go‑to‑market model with NVIDIA. NVIDIA’s direct investment in MediaTek is expected to boost customer confidence in the partnership, making them more willing to adopt MediaTek XPU together with the NVLink Fusion solution.

Huang pointed out that the $3.5 billion investment also signals that the relationship has moved beyond pure technology cooperation to a larger‑scale engineering and commercial integration, making MediaTek one of NVIDIA’s biggest partners. He added that he and Cai have known each other for 25 years, their relationship built on long‑term trust, and that this is not a one‑ or two‑year pilot but a ten‑year product roadmap; the investment demonstrates NVIDIA’s strong confidence in MediaTek and their joint future.

Cai added that the funds raised will be used for multiple purposes: strengthening the global supply chain, and further investing in chip design, ASICs, interconnect IP and advanced packaging capabilities to support larger AI projects down the line.

He admitted that MediaTek’s biggest challenge remains the supply chain, with pressure on HBM, substrates and other components. However, Taiwan sits at the core of the global AI infrastructure supply chain, and integrating NVIDIA’s supply‑chain resources will help MediaTek enhance its ability to take on large AI ASIC projects.

Huang also noted that through this cooperation, NVIDIA’s networking ecosystem will become part of MediaTek’s supply chain, and MediaTek’s XPU capability will be incorporated into NVIDIA’s ecosystem, effectively expanding both parties’ supply chains and product portfolios.

It is noteworthy that Huang disclosed NVIDIA’s next‑generation HBM will use a custom HBM architecture, with the bottom of the HBM stack employing a custom base layer designed by NVIDIA. This technology is being opened to NVLink Fusion partners, including MediaTek and Amazon (AMZN-US), and can be co‑integrated with custom XPU in advanced packaging.

This shows that the MediaTek‑NVIDIA collaboration now goes beyond chip‑to‑chip interconnect to encompass XPU, HBM, advanced packaging, networking and rack‑level AI Factory. For MediaTek, it provides a path from a pure ASIC design role to a full AI system platform; for NVIDIA, it allows more custom chips to be folded into its ecosystem via NVLink Fusion, expanding the value of each AI Factory.

items.title: 輝達砸35億美元認購聯發科ECB 結盟進軍AI工廠、客製化XPU
items.title_en: NVIDIA Invests $3.5 Billion in MediaTek ECB, Partnering to Build AI Factories and Custom XPU Solutions
paras: 聯發科(2454-TW)今(31)日宣布海外第一次無擔保轉換公司債(ECB)完成訂價，總募資金額達39億美元，折合新台幣超過1,200億元，創下台灣資本市場最高的ECB發行金額，其中，輝達(NVDA-US)投資金額達35億美元，以深化與聯發科的合作夥伴關係。
聯發科指出，在更緊密的合作架構下，聯發科將採用NVIDIA NVLink Fusion平台，協助超大規模雲端服務商(hyperscalers)、雲端服務供應商(cloud service providers)、前沿模型開發商(frontier model developers)等客戶開發客製化XPU，與建造以NVIDIA NVLink連結的機櫃級AI工廠。
雙方將結合NVIDIA的加速運算、人工智慧、圖形與軟體平台，以及聯發科在客製化晶片、高效能運算、高能效系統單晶片(SoC)設計、先進封裝、互連技術與網路連結各方面的領導地位。
聯發科預計與輝達在三大領域展開深度合作，包括AI基礎建設、邊緣AI運算以及車用，其中，AI基礎建設方面，聯發科將基於NVIDIA的NVLink Fusion生態系，協助客戶開發客製化AI基礎建設，並整合至NVIDIA機櫃級系統及AI工廠。
邊緣AI運算方面，雙方將持續合作開發未來數代RTX Spark與 DGX Spark電腦晶片，將整合NVIDIA GPU的聯發科系統單晶片帶入更多消費型電腦、適合AI開發者的超級電腦與企業級工作站中；車用方面，在實體AI世代下，聯發科與NVIDIA將持續開發具備AI功能的軟體定義汽車平台。
輝達創辦人暨執行長黃仁勳表示，AI 正在重新定義所有運算平台，涵蓋從全球大型 AI 工廠到個人電腦與汽車等領域。聯發科是全球領先的半導體公司之一，在系統單晶片設計、連網技術，以及高效能與高能效方面擁有深厚實力。透過更深度的合作，雙方正共同打造能將NVIDIA 加速運算技術拓展至更多新市場的平台，並讓客戶得以大規模建構具差異化優勢的 AI 系統。
聯發科副董事長暨執行長蔡力行表示，聯發科與NVIDIA對於將先進AI運算廣泛應用到各科技產業有著共同的願景。NVIDIA的投資強化我們在雲端AI基礎建設、邊緣AI運算及實體AI世代下的車用平台合作。雙方相信結合NVIDIA在加速運算及AI軟體生態系的領先地位，以及聯發科橫跨邊緣到雲端的多元 AI 技術布局，與在客製化晶片的領導地位，能為客戶加速實現創新。

聯發科將以NVIDIA NVLink Fusion平台為設計基礎，為客戶開發客製化AI加速器，使得客戶的平台隨著NVIDIA未來架構演進。NVLink Fusion平台為多晶粒(multi-die) XPU 架構的開發提供預先建置(prebuilt)、預先認證(prequalified)與系統級預先驗證(system-prevalidated)的平台，加速客戶從晶片、先進封裝到機櫃級系統的開發進程。
聯發科指出，打造客製化加速器只是將客製化XPU整合至機櫃級AI工廠的第一步，要將多晶粒架構、先進封裝、高速 SerDes、HBM、高速 I/O 及 scale-up 網路技術整合為可量產、可部署的完整系統，必須具備涵蓋晶片到機櫃層級的深厚工程能力、完整驗證流程，以及強大的供應鏈支援。
輝達與聯發科將提供量產佈署所需的NVLink連結、記憶體架構、封裝、製造及機櫃級技術，客戶無須從頭開發與驗證客製化 XPU 周邊的各項系統元件，更能將資源集中在打造平台核心優勢的差異化運算能力上。
聯發科亦可基於客戶的XPU設計，依照客戶的工作負載及基礎建設要求，客製網路連結、記憶體、封裝、性能及功耗等各項特性。此外，身為NVIDIA NVLink Fusion 生態系夥伴，聯發科技也能協助超大規模雲端業者、雲端服務供應商以及先進 AI 模型開發者，將客製化 XPU 無縫連接至 NVIDIA AI 基礎設施。
藉由 NVLink Fusion，合作夥伴得以運用 NVIDIA 經驗證的垂直擴充(scale-up) 與橫向擴充(scale-out) 互連技術、生態系資源，以及 MGX 機櫃級架構，降低開發複雜度、提升效能，加速半客製化 AI 工廠的開發與部署。
paras_en: MediaTek (2454‑TW) announced today that its first overseas unsecured convertible bond (ECB) pricing was completed, raising a total of $3.9 billion (over NT$1.2 trillion), the largest ECB issuance in Taiwan’s capital markets. NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) is investing $3.5 billion to deepen its partnership with MediaTek.

MediaTek said that under a tighter cooperation framework it will adopt NVIDIA’s NVLink Fusion platform to help hyperscalers, cloud service providers and frontier model developers create custom XPU solutions and build rack‑scale AI factories linked by NVIDIA NVLink.

The two companies will combine NVIDIA’s acceleration, AI, graphics and software platforms with MediaTek’s leadership in custom chips, high‑performance computing, power‑efficient SoC design, advanced packaging, interconnect technology and networking.

MediaTek plans deep collaboration with NVIDIA in three key areas: AI infrastructure, edge AI computing and automotive. For AI infrastructure, MediaTek will leverage NVIDIA’s NVLink Fusion ecosystem to help customers develop custom AI infrastructure and integrate it into NVIDIA rack‑scale systems and AI factories.

For edge AI computing, the partners will continue co‑developing future generations of RTX Spark and DGX Spark chips, bringing MediaTek SoCs with NVIDIA GPUs into more consumer PCs, AI‑focused supercomputers and enterprise workstations; for automotive, under the physical‑AI era, MediaTek and NVIDIA will keep developing software‑defined car platforms with AI capabilities.

NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang said AI is redefining every compute platform—from massive AI factories to personal computers and cars. MediaTek is a world‑leading semiconductor firm with deep expertise in SoC design, connectivity and high‑performance, power‑efficient solutions. Through deeper cooperation, the two are building platforms that extend NVIDIA’s acceleration tech into new markets and enable customers to build differentiated AI systems at scale.

MediaTek Vice‑Chairman and CEO Rick Tsai said MediaTek and NVIDIA share a vision of broadly applying advanced AI computing across tech industries. NVIDIA’s investment strengthens collaboration on cloud AI infrastructure, edge AI computing and automotive platforms for the physical‑AI era. Both believe that combining NVIDIA’s leadership in acceleration and AI software with MediaTek’s end‑to‑end AI technology stack and custom‑chip expertise will accelerate customer innovation.

MediaTek will use the NVIDIA NVLink Fusion platform as a design foundation to develop custom AI accelerators that evolve with NVIDIA’s future architectures. The NVLink Fusion platform provides pre‑built, pre‑qualified and system‑pre‑validated support for multi‑die XPU architectures, speeding customers’ development from chip and advanced packaging to rack‑scale systems.

MediaTek noted that building custom accelerators is only the first step toward integrating custom XPU into rack‑scale AI factories. To turn multi‑die architectures, advanced packaging, high‑speed SerDes, HBM, high‑speed I/O and scale‑up networking into mass‑produced, deployable systems, deep engineering capability from chip to rack, comprehensive validation and strong supply‑chain support are required.

NVIDIA and MediaTek will supply the NVLink connections, memory architecture, packaging, manufacturing and rack‑scale technology needed for volume deployment, so customers don’t have to develop and validate every custom XPU peripheral themselves and can focus on differentiating core compute performance.

MediaTek can also customize network links, memory, packaging, performance and power characteristics based on a customer’s XPU design, workload and infrastructure needs. As an NVLink Fusion ecosystem partner, MediaTek can help hyperscalers, cloud providers and advanced AI model developers seamlessly connect custom XPU to NVIDIA AI infrastructure.

Through NVLink Fusion, partners can leverage NVIDIA‑validated scale‑up and scale‑out interconnect technologies, ecosystem resources and the MGX rack‑scale architecture to reduce development complexity, boost performance and accelerate the creation and deployment of semi‑custom AI factories.

items.title: 輝達豪砸35億美元投資聯發科！黃仁勳押注台灣晶片大廠
items.title_en: Nvidia Plows $3.5 Billion into MediaTek! Jensen Huang Bets on Taiwan Chip Giant
paras: 根據《彭博》報導，輝達(NVDA-US)周一(31日)宣布，將斥資35億美元投資聯發科(2454-TW)，進一步深化與這家台灣晶片設計大廠的合作，藉此推動更多企業採用能夠接入輝達資料中心生態系的晶片與互連技術。
根據兩家公司發布的聯合聲明，輝達將購買可轉換為聯發科股票的債券。這項合作將擴大雙方原有的夥伴關係，聯發科未來將採用輝達NVLink Fusion及最新發表的NVHBM技術，讓資料中心內不同晶片與零組件能夠更順暢地傳輸資料。
聯發科正積極拓展客製化AI晶片市場，希望協助資料中心業者設計自有晶片，並向博通(AVGO-US)與邁威爾(MRVL-US)發起挑戰。聯發科今年稍早已與Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google建立合作，逐漸成為大型科技公司開發自研AI晶片的重要設計夥伴，也帶動其市值在近幾個月增至約原來的3倍。
對輝達而言，這筆投資不只是入股聯發科，更是鞏固AI硬體生態系主導地位的最新布局。即使亞馬遜(AMZN-US)、Google及微軟(MSFT-US)等大型客戶持續開發自有AI晶片，輝達仍希望透過NVLink Fusion等資料中心互連技術，維持在整體硬體供應鏈中的核心角色，而非僅依賴領先市場的AI加速器。
輝達先前也與亞馬遜達成類似協議，後者同意額外部署200萬個輝達零組件，並承諾讓內部自研晶片採用輝達的連接技術。這代表即使雲端業者部署原本意在取代輝達加速器的晶片，輝達仍能透過網路與互連平台參與AI資料中心擴建商機。
不過，輝達近年頻繁投資客戶、競爭對手及其他AI企業，也引發市場對「循環投資」的疑慮，擔心資金最終可能回流為輝達產品訂單，製造出虛假需求。輝達強烈否認相關說法，管理層表示，這些投資只是加快技術普及，並促進AI產業發展。
儘管自研晶片競爭升溫，目前仍未見輝達霸主地位明顯鬆動。公司預估明年營收將大增70%，並持續從AI資料中心龐大支出中取得最大利益。
聯發科先前已協助輝達進軍筆電市場，參與RTX Spark產品開發。面對AI熱潮，聯發科也計畫積極擴大招募，預估今年AI晶片營收約20億美元，並以明年拿下規模800億美元資料中心市場最高15%市占率為目標。
paras_en: According to Bloomberg, Nvidia (NVDA-US) announced on Monday (the 31st) that it will invest $3.5 billion in MediaTek (2454-TW), deepening its cooperation with the Taiwanese chip‑design powerhouse to drive more enterprises to adopt chips and interconnect technologies that can plug into Nvidia’s data‑center ecosystem.

In a joint statement released by the two companies, Nvidia will purchase bonds that can be converted into MediaTek shares. The partnership will expand the existing relationship, with MediaTek slated to adopt Nvidia’s NVLink Fusion and the newly announced NVHBM technology, enabling smoother data transfer among different chips and components inside data centers.

MediaTek is actively expanding its custom AI‑chip market, aiming to help data‑center operators design their own silicon and challenge Broadcom (AVGO-US) and Marvell (MRVL-US). Earlier this year MediaTek struck a partnership with Google, a subsidiary of Alphabet (GOOGL-US), gradually becoming a key design partner for large tech firms developing in‑house AI chips, and its market value has risen to roughly three times its level just a few months ago.

For Nvidia, the investment is not merely a stake in MediaTek but the latest move to cement its dominance in the AI‑hardware ecosystem. Even as major customers such as Amazon (AMZN-US), Google and Microsoft (MSFT-US) continue to develop their own AI chips, Nvidia hopes to maintain a core role in the overall hardware supply chain through NVLink Fusion and other data‑center interconnect technologies, rather than relying solely on its market‑leading AI accelerators.

Nvidia previously struck a similar deal with Amazon, under which the cloud giant agreed to deploy an additional 2 million Nvidia components and pledged to use Nvidia’s interconnect technology in its internally‑developed chips. This shows that even when cloud providers roll out chips intended to replace Nvidia’s accelerators, Nvidia can still participate in AI data‑center expansion opportunities via its networking and interconnect platform.

However, Nvidia’s recent spate of investments in customers, rivals and other AI firms has sparked market concerns about “circular investing,” with worries that the capital could ultimately flow back into Nvidia product orders, creating artificial demand. Nvidia strongly denies these claims, with management stating the investments are simply meant to accelerate technology adoption and foster AI industry growth.

Despite intensifying competition in custom‑chip development, Nvidia’s dominant position shows no clear signs of weakening. The company projects a 70% surge in revenue next year and expects to continue extracting the bulk of profits from the massive spending on AI data centers.

MediaTek has previously helped Nvidia enter the laptop market by participating in the development of RTX Spark products. Riding the AI wave, MediaTek also plans to ramp up hiring, forecasts AI‑chip revenue of about $2 billion this year, and aims to capture up to 15% of the $80 billion data‑center market by next year.

items.title: 貿協率華碩、創見登史國參展 展現AI與綠色農業助攻非洲市場
items.title_en: Trade Council Highlights Asus, Inventec at Historic National Exhibition Showcasing AI and Green Agriculture for African Market
paras: 為深化我國與非洲友邦經貿鏈結，精準搶進非洲自由貿易區(AfCFTA)龐大商機，外交部委辦貿協於第58屆「史瓦帝尼國際商展」(EITF)籌組「台灣館」，集結26家台商組成國家隊，將台灣在「AI智慧城市」與「綠色農業」的核心優勢完整呈現。
貿協表市，上周8月28日的開幕儀式由史瓦帝尼國王恩史瓦帝三世與我國駐史代理大使崔靜麟共同剪綵，並邀波札那貿易暨創業部長Hon. Tiroeaone Ntsima、史國商工暨貿易部長Hon. Manqoba Khumalo等政要出席，展現台灣以經貿實力鞏固邦誼、拓展南部非洲市場的戰略成果。
開展首日，恩史瓦帝三世在崔靜麟陪同下親赴台灣館巡視，對臺灣前瞻技術的在地應用給予高度評價，資拓宏宇繼去年協助史國首都建置5G監控系統後，今(2026)年進一步導入AI醫療與電商解決方案；哈森蓖麻農場則展出具備ESG概念的綠色供應鏈，計畫將史國打造成串聯全球的蓖麻油加工與出口基地，雙雙獲得國王的高度認同，為臺史產業深度結盟立下新指標。
在商業效益方面，台灣館精準對接南部非洲對「數位轉型」與「民生基礎建設」的強烈需求，由華碩(2357-TW)、BenQ及創見(2451-TW)等大廠領軍的「智慧生活台灣精品體驗專區」，以AI迷你電腦及穿戴式設備成為全場焦點。
此外，傳統與民生產業亦締造豐碩戰果：伊利諾的高性價比手推車因符合當地市場需求，吸引多方代理洽談熱潮；去年首次參展的黑蟻工業，展出的防毒面具及五金工具深獲當地青睞，目前已在史國設公司並尋找更大的發貨倉庫及設廠；而極智、達兒周及華紐等首次參展的生技與美妝團隊，亦成功吸引在地女性買主，展現台灣深厚的生技研發實力。
除了硬核的產業鏈結，貿協表示，台灣館更透過「軟實力」推動國民外交。展區特設的休閒食品區與童玩體驗區，以台灣深具代表性的愛玉、鳳梨酥、香菇素肉乾及互動遊戲，成功拉近與當地民眾的距離。
貿協強調，史瓦帝尼國際商展為當地年度最具規模的綜合展，本次參展企業有高達6成為二次回訪，顯見台商對深耕南部非洲市場深具信心。未來，貿協將持續打造優質的海外實體拓銷平台，協助台灣優勢產業穩健鏈結全球新興市場，讓MIT的創新實力在世界舞台持續發光。
paras_en: To deepen Taiwan's economic and trade ties with its African partner nations and precisely capture the massive opportunities of the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA), the Ministry of Foreign Affairs’ Trade Council organized a "Taiwan Pavilion" at the 58th "Eswatini International Trade Fair" (EITF), gathering 26 Taiwanese companies as a national team to fully present Taiwan’s core strengths in "AI smart cities" and "green agriculture".

The Trade Council reported that the opening ceremony on August 28 was jointly cut by King Mswati III of Eswatini and Taiwan’s chargé d'affaires to Eswatini, Chui Jing‑Lin, with officials such as Botswana’s Minister of Trade and Entrepreneurship Hon. Tiroeaone Ntsima and Eswatini’s Minister of Commerce and Trade Hon. Manqoba Khumalo in attendance, demonstrating Taiwan’s strategic results in consolidating friendships and expanding the Southern African market through economic and trade strength.

On the first day, King Mswati III, accompanied by Chui Jing‑Lin, personally toured the Taiwan Pavilion and gave high praise to the local application of Taiwan’s forward‑looking technologies. After helping the capital set up a 5G monitoring system last year, Inventec (formerly Giga-Byte) further introduced AI‑driven medical and e‑commerce solutions in 2026; the Hasson Castor Farm displayed an ESG‑oriented green supply chain, planning to turn Eswatini into a global hub for castor‑oil processing and export. Both received the king’s strong endorsement, setting a new benchmark for deep Taiwan‑Eswatini industrial alliances.

In terms of commercial impact, the Taiwan Pavilion precisely matched Southern Africa’s strong demand for “digital transformation” and “basic livelihood infrastructure,” featuring a "Smart Living Taiwan精品 Experience Zone" led by major firms such as Asus (2357‑TW), BenQ and Inventec (2451‑TW), where AI mini‑computers and wearable devices became the highlight of the exhibition.

Traditional and consumer‑focused industries also achieved fruitful results: Illinois‑made high‑value‑for‑price hand‑carts met local market needs and sparked intense agency negotiations; Black Ant Industries, a first‑time exhibitor last year, saw its gas‑mask and hardware tools warmly received and has now set up a company in Eswatini while seeking larger warehouses and a factory; biotech and beauty teams making their debut, including Jizhi, Da’er Zhou and Hua Niu, successfully attracted local female buyers, showcasing Taiwan’s strong biotech R&D capabilities.

Beyond hard‑core industry linkages, the Trade Council said the Taiwan Pavilion also promoted people‑to‑people diplomacy through “soft power.” A dedicated leisure‑food zone and a children’s play area offered iconic Taiwanese products such as aiyu jelly, pineapple cake, mushroom‑based meat jerky and interactive games, effectively bridging the gap with local residents.

The Trade Council emphasized that the Eswatini International Trade Fair is the region’s largest annual comprehensive exhibition, with up to 60% of participating companies returning for a second visit, reflecting Taiwanese firms’ confidence in deepening their presence in Southern Africa. Going forward, the Trade Council will continue to build high‑quality overseas physical sales platforms to help Taiwan’s advantageous industries securely connect with emerging global markets, allowing MIT’s innovative strength to keep shining on the world stage.

items.title: 〈凱基金法說〉ONE KGI展綜效 楊文鈞：銀證互相導客帶入逾600億元利潤
paras: 凱基金控(2883-TW)今(31)日舉行法說會，銀行與證券子公司上半年獲利大爆發，「ONE KGI」策略展現驚人綜效，金控總經理楊文鈞表示，集團內同時跟銀行、證券有業務往來的客戶數，比2024年底大幅增加35%，透過子公司團隊合作與客戶轉介，光是銀行跟證券就分別為集團導入了超過300億元的利潤。
凱基銀行2026年上半年稅後純益42.8億元，年增 27%，其中財富管理手續費年增30%，連續3年成長逾20%，年化股東權益報酬率提升至11.1%。個金業務方面，透過證券交割戶移轉、收付處增加及銀行數位投放，個金存款新戶年增67%。存款結構持續優化，全行活期存款比重達45%，個人金融活存比亦提高至61%，有助降低資金成本。
截至6月底，凱基銀亞資專區客戶數已突破450戶，資產管理規模逾310億元，專區績效排名第六；此外，香港分行已申請財富管理及私人銀行業務執照，積極拓展跨境財富管理與高資產客群商機。
凱基銀行總經理林素真指出，隨著活存比拉高，大幅降低了資金成本，上半年淨利差(NIM)提升到1.43%，預期全年可望維持此水準，也不排除再往上修。
凱基銀分行版圖擴增至 53 家，香港分行自去年 7 月開業以來獲客效益顯著，上半年開戶數大幅成長 1.6 倍，存款規模更已提前達成年度目標八成以上。為深化差異化優勢，香港分行積極打造 Web 3.0 友善生態圈，帶動虛擬資產相關客戶占比提升至 15%；此外，亦於 6 月 12 日正式遞交香港私人銀行與財務管理執照申請，未來將善用集團跨子公司協同效應，全力拓展高資產與創新客群。
凱基證券2026年上半年稅後純益179.4億元，較去年同期大幅成長383%，年化股東權益報酬率達48.1%，表現優於同業。今年上半年台股交投熱絡、價量齊揚，台股指數續創新高，股權承銷主辦案件總金額達477億元，市占率41%，穩居業界第一，帶動承銷手續費收入創下歷史新高；經紀業務市占率亦穩居市場第二。財富管理業務方面，營收年增61%，資產管理規模達4,144億元，年增39%，業務規模穩健擴張。
不過，隨著股市大漲，投資人對於「不限用途款項借貸」等融資需求也跟著水漲船高，法人關注凱基證券會不會出現「資金很緊」的問題？凱基證券總經理林志宏回應，今年台股確實熱到不行，市場資金需求相當殷切，但公司早已超前部署，證券供給的資金已經從去年底的2500億元增加到今年6月底的3700億元，大增1200億元。
林志宏表示，公司透過銀行短天期貸款、發行金融債、次債以及結構型商品等長短天期「組合拳」，分散了籌資管道。截至 7 月，凱基證券的資本適足率(BIS)依然維持在260%以上的安全水位，下半年也會與金控討論評估發債與增資計畫，確保手上有滿滿的彈藥，隨時支援投資人的熱烈需求。

items.title: 吳東亮提10餘項企業建言 籲政府應弭平K型發展落差
items.title_en: Wu Dongliang Presents Over 10 Corporate Recommendations, Urges Government to Bridge K‑Shape Development Gap
paras: 工商協進會理事長吳東亮今(31)日率領第27屆理監事共32位產業界人士，前往總統府會見總統賴清德，吳東亮就工商界高度關切之議題，當面呈遞包含促進金融發展等10餘項建言書，涵蓋能源重組、稅負、觀光及文創等。吳東亮也呼籲政府持續推進台美稅務協商、提升能源與電網韌性，加速落實「AI產業化、產業AI化」，以有效弭平K型經濟發展落差。
吳東亮表示，對政府團隊傾力協助產業界因應美國關稅挑戰、支持企業赴海外打造產業聚落向政府表達謝意，也代表工商界亦以實際行動力挺政府政策，在國發會赴美投資信保機制中，目前有15家出資金融機構即有13家為工商協進會會員。
吳東亮指出，台灣經濟表現亮眼，去年經濟成長率居亞洲之冠，今(2026)年上半年更高達14.15%，創下半世紀以來最強表現，躍升為世界前20大兆元經濟體，台股市值亦攀升至全球前5大市場，年化漲幅高達40%。他也期盼立法院能如期完成明(2027)年度總預算案審查。
工商協進會表示，與會理監事亦針對產界核心關切議題踴躍建言，包括在財政餘裕下改善勞健保財務結構、藉由政策誘因提升電動載具普及率、健全技職教育並積極延攬海外人才、推動廢棄土方資源循環再利用，將觀光業列為服務出口重點產業，以及台灣律師養成教育改革等。
工商協進會表示，包含上述議題在內，涵蓋能源重組、稅負、觀光及文創等攸關企業營運之10餘項書面建言，已全數彙整成冊，由理事長當面呈交總統參採，並允諾交由相關部會研議處理。
paras_en: Chairman Wu Dongliang of the Industrial Association led the 27th Board of Directors and 32 industry leaders to the Presidential Office on the 31st to meet President Lai Ching‑de, presenting a memorandum of over ten recommendations—including promoting financial development, energy restructuring, tax burdens, tourism, and cultural creativity—to address issues of high concern to the business community.

Wu expressed gratitude to the government for its vigorous support in helping industry cope with U.S. tariff challenges and for backing enterprises in building overseas industrial clusters. He noted that 15 financial institutions have invested in the National Development Council’s U.S. investment guarantee mechanism, 13 of which are members of the Industrial Association.

He highlighted Taiwan’s strong economic performance, noting last year’s growth rate topped Asia, and that the first half of 2026 saw a 14.15% increase, the strongest in half a century, propelling Taiwan into the world’s top 20 trillion‑dollar economies and ranking its stock market among the top five globally with an annual gain of 40%. He also urged the Legislative Yuan to complete the 2027 budget review on schedule.

The Industrial Association said the attending directors and supervisors actively proposed solutions to core industry concerns, such as improving the financial structure of labor and health insurance under fiscal surplus, boosting electric vehicle adoption through policy incentives, strengthening vocational education and attracting overseas talent, promoting the recycling of abandoned earthworks, positioning tourism as a key export service industry, and reforming lawyer training in Taiwan.

The Association confirmed that the memorandum, covering energy restructuring, tax burdens, tourism, cultural creativity, and more than ten other operational issues, has been compiled into a single volume and presented directly to the President, with a promise that relevant ministries will study and address the proposals.

items.title: 蘋果「老臣」又少一位？希勒卸兩大要職、退休腳步近了
items.title_en: Apple Veteran Schiller Steps Down from Two Major Roles, Retirement Looms
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)高層世代交替持續加速。在新任執行長特納斯(John Ternus)周二(1日)正式接棒前夕，橫跨賈伯斯(Steve Jobs)與庫克(Tim Cook)時代的資深高層希勒(Phil Schiller)，近日已卸下App Store及產品發表會兩大管理職務，被內部視為朝最終退休邁出的重要一步。
《彭博》引述知情人士報導，現年66歲的希勒仍將留在蘋果，保有「Apple Fellow」頭銜，並向員工表示未來將參與其他尚未公開的專案。蘋果發言人對此拒絕置評。
希勒曾長期擔任蘋果全球行銷資深副總裁，直到2020年卸任。他是蘋果過去數十年最具代表性的高層之一，不僅曾親自發表多款重要產品，也參與iPhone、iPad、iPod及多款Mac的關鍵決策，並與賈伯斯共同主導App Store的誕生。
此次異動正值蘋果權力交接的重要時刻。庫克結束15年執行長生涯後轉任執行董事長，特納斯則正式接掌公司。隨著希勒淡出核心管理職務，特納斯上任後面臨的一大挑戰，就是如何因應資深高層接連離開或退居二線。
近年蘋果已有多名重量級主管異動，包括前營運長威廉斯(Jeff Williams)、前硬體主管里奇奧(Dan Riccio)、前財務長梅斯特里(Luca Maestri)，以及環境與政府事務主管傑克森(Lisa Jackson)等人，均已卸任或轉任較小職務。此外，前法務長與Apple Pay部門主管也預計10月離職。
希勒卸下職務後，App Store將重新劃歸由資深主管庫伊(Eddy Cue)領導的服務事業部。庫伊過去曾負責App Store，直到2015年相關業務才交由希勒與行銷部門管理。此次調整也意味著，庫伊在特納斯時代的影響力將進一步擴大。
App Store日常營運則將由資深主管奧利佛(Carson Oliver)負責，並直接向庫伊報告。原先負責第三方應用程式市集及App分發工具的Thai(Ann Thai)，未來將改向奧利佛報告；Apple Arcade遊戲服務也將納入其管理範圍。
希勒掌管App Store期間，職責遠超過管理這個估計每年創造逾300億美元營收的平台。他長期負責爭議性App的上架與否決策、開發者關係，以及因應各國監管與訴訟調整App Store政策和收入分潤制度，也曾代表蘋果面對《要塞英雄》(Fortnite)開發商Epic Games的長期法律攻防。
另一方面，希勒自2020年卸下行銷主管後仍持續掌管蘋果全球活動及產品發表會業務，如今也將相關職責交給自2023年起擔任其副手的Nola Weinstein。這項交接正值蘋果9月9日舉行秋季發表會前夕，屆時預料將推出首款摺疊iPhone及新一代Apple Watch。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) senior leadership turnover is accelerating. On the eve of new CEO John Ternus officially taking the helm on Tuesday (the 1st), veteran executive Phil Schiller, who spans the Steve Jobs and Tim Cook eras, has recently relinquished his two major management posts overseeing the App Store and product launch events, a move seen internally as a key step toward his ultimate retirement.

Bloomberg, citing sources, reported that the 66‑year‑old Schiller will remain at Apple with the title of “Apple Fellow” and has told staff he will take part in other, as‑yet‑unannounced projects. Apple’s spokesperson declined to comment.

Schiller long served as senior vice president of worldwide marketing until stepping down in 2020. He has been one of Apple’s most iconic executives for decades, personally unveiling numerous flagship products, shaping key decisions for the iPhone, iPad, iPod and various Macs, and co‑leading the creation of the App Store alongside Jobs.

The reshuffle comes at a pivotal moment of power transition at Apple. After 15 years as CEO, Cook is moving to the role of executive chairman, while Ternus formally assumes the chief executive post. With Schiller stepping back from core management, Ternus inherits the challenge of navigating a wave of senior departures and semi‑retirements.

In recent years Apple has seen several heavyweight executives move on, including former COO Jeff Williams, former hardware chief Dan Riccio, former CFO Luca Maestri and environmental and government affairs head Lisa Jackson, all of whom have either left or shifted to smaller roles. Additionally, the former general counsel and head of Apple Pay are slated to depart in October.

Following Schiller’s exit, the App Store will be reassigned to the Services division led by senior executive Eddy Cue. Cue previously oversaw the App Store until 2015, when those responsibilities were transferred to Schiller and the marketing organization. The change signals an expansion of Cue’s influence in the Ternus era.

Day‑to‑day App Store operations will be handled by senior manager Carson Oliver, who will report directly to Cue. Ann Thai, who previously managed the third‑party app marketplace and distribution tools, will now report to Oliver, and Apple Arcade will also fall under his purview.

During Schiller’s tenure overseeing the App Store, his responsibilities far exceeded running a platform that generates more than $30 billion in annual revenue. He handled contentious app approvals, developer relations, and adjustments to App Store policies and revenue‑share structures in response to global regulators and lawsuits, and he represented Apple in the protracted legal battle with Epic Games over Fortnite.

Separately, after stepping down as head of marketing in 2020, Schiller continued to run Apple’s global events and product launches. Those duties are now being handed over to Nola Weinstein, who has served as his deputy since 2023. The handoff comes just before Apple’s September 9 fall event, where the company is expected to unveil its first foldable iPhone and a new generation of Apple Watch.

items.title: 蘋果「庫克時代」正式落幕！最後一封員工信吐露15年真心話
items.title_en: Apple’s “Cook Era” Officially Ends! Final Employee Letter Reveals 15 Years of Heartfelt Reflections
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)執行長庫克(Tim Cook)周一(31日)正式卸下執行長職務，結束長達15年的掌舵生涯。他在任內最後一封致全體員工信中坦言，自己將非常想念這份深愛的工作，但對於把公司交棒給新任執行長特納斯(John Ternus)感到無比安心，並相信後者有能力帶領蘋果邁向下一個階段。
庫克自2011年8月接替蘋果共同創辦人賈伯斯(Steve Jobs)出任執行長，在位期間見證Apple Watch、AirPods等產品問世，同時持續擴大iPhone、iPad與Mac產品線，帶領蘋果締造一段創紀錄的15年執行長任期。
庫克在信中表示，「今天是我擔任蘋果執行長的最後一天」，儘管早已知道這一天終將到來，但真正面對時仍感到難以置信。他感謝員工多年來的付出，並將自己的成就歸功於整個團隊，稱自己從未見過如此傑出的一群人。
回顧蘋果文化，庫克表示，他最自豪的並不是財報能夠呈現的數字，而是公司證明「文化勝過一切」。蘋果員工共同相信，他們打造的產品具有意義，也肩負讓世界變得更好的責任。正是這種信念，讓團隊能彼此激發潛能，實現賈伯斯口中在宇宙留下「一道印記」的願景。
談到卸任心情，庫克坦言，雖然自己並未離開蘋果，但正告別一個深愛的職位，「我將以現在甚至難以想像的方式想念這份工作」，但同時強調，自己對卸任決定已完全釋然。
對於接班人特納斯，庫克則給予高度評價。他表示，很少有人能像特納斯一樣理解打造「改變世界產品」所需要的一切，並形容他聰明、優秀且能力出眾，「我對他的領導再期待不過」。
庫克卸任後並不會離開蘋果，而是轉任執行董事長，未來仍將代表公司處理與全球各國政府的關係，包括美國與中國等重要市場。他也向員工表示，期待未來以新的身分繼續在Apple Park以及世界各地與大家見面。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) CEO Tim Cook formally stepped down from the chief executive role on Monday (the 31st), ending a 15‑year tenure at the helm. In his last letter to all employees, he admitted he will deeply miss the job he loves, but feels completely confident handing the company over to new CEO John Ternus, believing Ternus has the ability to lead Apple into its next phase.

Cook succeeded co‑founder Steve Jobs as CEO in August 2011. During his time in office he oversaw the launch of products such as the Apple Watch and AirPods, while continuously expanding the iPhone, iPad and Mac lines, guiding Apple through a record‑setting 15‑year run as chief executive.

In the letter Cook wrote, “Today is my last day as Apple’s CEO.” Although he had long known the day would come, facing it in reality still felt surreal. He thanked employees for years of dedication and credited his achievements to the entire team, saying he had never seen such an outstanding group of people.

Reflecting on Apple’s culture, Cook said his greatest pride isn’t the numbers on the financial statements but the proof that “culture beats everything.” Apple staff share the belief that the products they create are meaningful and carry a responsibility to make the world better. This conviction, he said, fuels the team’s ability to inspire one another and fulfill the vision Steve Jobs spoke of—leaving a “mark in the universe.”

Speaking about his feelings on stepping down, Cook confessed that although he isn’t leaving Apple, he is saying goodbye to a beloved role. “I will miss this job in ways I can’t even imagine now,” he wrote, while emphasizing that he is fully at peace with his decision to step aside.

Regarding his successor Ternus, Cook gave high praise, noting that few people understand what it takes to build “world‑changing products” as well as Ternus does. He described him as smart, excellent and exceptionally capable, adding, “I could not have higher expectations for his leadership.”

After stepping down as CEO, Cook will not leave Apple; he will become Executive Chairman, continuing to represent the company in dealings with governments worldwide, including key markets such as the United States and China. He told employees he looks forward to meeting them in his new role at Apple Park and around the globe.

items.title: Fed傳聲筒：升息規則變了！如今不是為何升 而是憑什麼不升
items.title_en: Fed Spokesperson: The Rules for Raising Rates Have Changed! It's No Longer About Why to Raise, but Why Not to Raise
paras: 被市場視為「Fed傳聲筒」的《華爾街日報》(The Wall Street Journal)記者Nick Timiraos日前撰文指出，聯準會(Fed)主席華許上周在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會的演說，不僅降低外界對其抗通膨立場的疑慮，更悄悄改變9月利率決策的門檻：Fed如今可能需要看到足夠疲弱的通膨數據，才有理由繼續按兵不動。
華許演說後，投資人已認為9月升息的可能性高於不升息。巴克萊(Barclays)(BCS-US)及法國興業銀行(Societe Generale)等機構也調整預測，轉而預期Fed將在9月及12月各升息一次。

按兵不動不再是Fed的預設選項

Timiraos指出，華許演說中有兩項觀察明顯偏向升息。首先，他認為目前金融環境很難被稱為具有限制性；其次，6月及7月較溫和的通膨數據，尚未讓他相信潛在物價趨勢已經改善。
利率抑制通膨的主要途徑，是提高借貸成本、降低需求。若借貸條件並不緊縮，通膨又沒有穩定下降，就意味著利率可能還不夠高。
Fed前副主席柯恩(Donald Kohn)認為，在華許演說前，Fed的預設立場是維持利率不變，除非數據提出採取行動的充分理由；如今這項邏輯已經翻轉，Fed可能傾向升息，除非接下來的數據證明沒有必要。
這使9月11日公布的8月消費者物價指數(CPI)，成為9月15日至16日利率會議前的關鍵考驗。華許雖然曾表示，不會過度重視任何單月數據，但若8月通膨再次降溫，便可能與前兩個月構成更明確的改善趨勢，為Fed按兵不動提供依據。
相反地，若8月CPI表現強勁，將削弱通膨正朝2%目標回落的說法。Fed屆時若仍維持利率不變，恐重新引發市場對華許是否有意願採取行動的懷疑。

Fed內部裂痕可能在9月進一步擴大

華許並未預先承諾9月升息。曾任英國央行決策官員的Forbes表示，市場不應把這場演說直接視為政策訊號，因為華許已明確表達，利率決定應在會議中根據當時資訊做出，而不是提前向市場給出答案。
然而，華許在演說中為7月按兵不動所提出的理由，主要是等待供應鏈、投資流向及地緣政治等新資訊，而不是論證目前利率水準已足以壓低通膨。若8月數據沒有明顯轉弱，Fed在9月繼續不升息，華許恐再次面臨難以充分解釋政策立場的困境。
堪薩斯城聯準銀行前總裁Thomas Hoenig警告，華許若無法清楚說明按兵不動的理由，可能損害自身公信力。
Fed決策官員目前也明顯分裂。7月會議已有3名官員反對維持利率不變，另有至少2名當時沒有投票權的官員認為應該升息。鷹派官員擔憂，即使8月通膨數據稍微降溫，關稅、中東衝突及AI投資規模仍會持續推高物價。
另一派官員並不反對最終升息，但認為若每月通膨數據延續6月及7月的降溫趨勢，現在行動可能是錯誤決定。還有部分官員介於兩者之間，原本支持7月按兵不動，9月卻可能轉向升息，使反對維持利率不變的人數超過上次會議。

升息將正面撞上白宮政治壓力

芝加哥聯準銀行總裁古爾斯比(Austan Goolsbee)認為，目前最大的問題是判斷通膨究竟來自短暫供給衝擊，還是需求超過經濟供給能力。若AI投資熱潮造成的過熱現象擴散至整體經濟，Fed便必須以升息回應，政策方向不再模糊。
但供給衝擊也接連出現。關稅並非一次性事件，新措施不斷疊加，部分關稅遭法院推翻後又有其他措施接續上路，使Fed更難判斷物價壓力是否會自然消退。
此外，9月升息距離11月初期中選舉僅剩數周，可能打亂川普政府宣稱通膨已受控制的政治訊息。川普近來雖未像過去攻擊前主席鮑爾那樣公開施壓華許，但曾暗示華許本人傾向維持利率不變，是其他決策官員推動升息。
Hoenig坦言，認為政治壓力不會影響央行官員並不切實際，即使決策者努力將政治因素排除在外，壓力仍始終存在。
Timiraos認為，華許的演說證明他願意回應外界批評。他重新確認Fed的2%通膨目標，也不再重提AI將壓低物價、允許Fed更快降息的舊論點。如今，真正考驗將落在9月：若CPI沒有明顯降溫，華許就必須在升息引發白宮不滿，與按兵不動損害Fed公信力之間做出選擇。
paras_en: The Wall Street Journal reporter Nick Timiraos, often seen as the Fed's spokesperson, wrote that Fed Chair Jerome Powell's speech at the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Meeting last week not only reduced external doubts about his anti‑inflation stance, but also quietly shifted the threshold for the September rate decision: the Fed may now need to see sufficiently weak inflation data before it has a reason to hold steady.

After Powell's speech, investors have come to believe that a September rate hike is more likely than a hold. Institutions such as Barclays (BCS‑US) and Societe Generale have also revised their forecasts, now expecting the Fed to raise rates once in September and once in December.

Holding steady is no longer the Fed's default option. Timiraos notes that Powell's remarks contained two observations that clearly leaned toward a hike. First, he said the current financial environment is hard to describe as restrictive; second, the milder inflation data in June and July have not convinced him that underlying price trends have improved.

The main way interest rates curb inflation is by raising borrowing costs and dampening demand. If borrowing conditions are not tightening and inflation is not steadily falling, it suggests rates may still not be high enough.

Former Fed Vice‑Chair Donald Kohn said that before Powell's speech the Fed's default stance was to keep rates unchanged unless the data provided a compelling reason to act; that logic has now flipped, and the Fed may lean toward a hike unless upcoming data show no need for it.

This makes the August CPI, released on September 11, a crucial test before the September 15‑16 policy meeting. Powell has said he will not over‑emphasize any single month’s data, but if August inflation cools again it could form a clearer improvement trend with the previous two months, giving the Fed a basis to hold steady.

Conversely, a strong August CPI would weaken the case that inflation is moving back toward the 2% target. If the Fed then kept rates unchanged, it could revive market doubts about Powell’s willingness to act.

Internal Fed divisions could widen further in September. Powell did not pre‑commit to a September hike. Former Bank of England policymaker Forbes warned markets should not treat the speech as a policy signal, because Powell made clear that rate decisions will be made at the meeting based on the information then available, not by giving the market an advance answer.

However, the reason Powell gave for holding steady in July was mainly to await new information on supply chains, investment flows and geopolitics, not to argue that current rates were sufficient to suppress inflation. If August data do not show a clear weakening, a continued hold in September could again leave Powell struggling to fully explain the policy stance.
Former Kansas City Fed President Thomas Hoenig warned that if Powell cannot clearly articulate the rationale for holding steady, his credibility could be damaged.

Fed policymakers are now visibly split. At the July meeting three officials voted against keeping rates unchanged, and at least two officials without voting rights thought a hike was warranted. Hawkish members worry that even if August inflation eases slightly, tariffs, Middle‑East conflicts and the scale of AI investment will continue to push prices up.

The other camp does not oppose a eventual hike but believes that if monthly inflation data continue the cooling seen in June and July, acting now could be a mistake. Some officials sit in the middle, having supported the July hold but now possibly shifting to a hike in September, which would push the number of opponents of a hold above that at the last meeting.

A rate hike would run head‑on into political pressure from the White House. Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee says the biggest question now is whether inflation stems from a temporary supply shock or from demand outpacing economic capacity. If the AI investment boom overheats the broader economy, the Fed would have to respond with hikes, ending any ambiguity in policy direction.

But supply‑side shocks keep arriving. Tariffs are not a one‑off; new measures keep stacking, and some tariffs overturned by courts are replaced by other actions, making it harder for the Fed to judge whether price pressures will naturally recede.

Moreover, a September hike would come just weeks before the early‑November midterm elections, potentially disrupting the Trump administration’s political narrative that inflation is under control. While Trump has not recently pressured Powell as he did former Chair Powell, he has hinted that Powell himself leans toward holding rates steady while other officials push for a hike.
Hoenig admits that believing political pressure will not affect central‑bank officials is unrealistic; even if policymakers try to insulate decisions from politics, the pressure remains ever present.

Timiraos concludes that Powell’s speech shows he is willing to respond to external criticism. He reaffirmed the Fed’s 2% inflation goal and dropped the old talking point that AI would lower prices and allow faster rate cuts. The real test now lies in September: if CPI does not cool noticeably, Powell will have to choose between a hike that angers the White House and holding steady at the risk of damaging the Fed’s credibility.

items.title: 假色情App竟會偷偷轉走存款！Meta急下架數十則詐騙廣告
items.title_en: Meta Quickly Removes Dozens of Fraud Ads After Scam Apps Pretend to Be Porn Sites and Steal Deposits
paras: Meta(META-US)周一(31日)下架數十則臉書(Facebook)與Instagram廣告。印度政府發現，詐騙集團利用帶有露骨色情內容的廣告，誘騙用戶下載惡意安卓(Android)應用程式，藉此竊取網路銀行登入資料，甚至直接轉走帳戶資金。
印度政府指出，這些廣告以「Night Play」、「Kyss」等名稱在臉書及Instagram投放，點擊後會將用戶導向網路釣魚網站。近期當局觀察到，偽裝成色情App的惡意安卓應用程式明顯增加，並被用於發動金融詐騙。
《路透》在印度政府周一發布警示後，仍發現至少39則相關廣告處於刊登狀態，其中許多使用露骨影片縮圖吸引用戶點擊。《路透》向Meta提出詢問並通報後，Meta隨即移除所有相關廣告，但未回應置評要求。
其中一則廣告會將用戶導向宣稱提供數百部色情影片及全天候內容的網站。用戶若要觀看，必須繞過官方應用程式商店，直接下載名為「Movexa.apk」的安裝檔。
印度政府警告，這類惡意App可能在用戶不知情的情況下，存取手機內儲存的資訊、攔截一次性密碼(OTP)與銀行個人識別碼(PIN)，並從銀行帳戶轉走資金。
印度2025年因網路詐騙蒙受的損失接近24億美元。隨著數位支付在當地快速普及，詐騙集團也日益將印度用戶列為主要目標。這也是印度政府近幾周第二度對大型科技平台上的金融詐騙提出警告。印度先前要求Google關閉Firebase平台上的數百個帳戶，原因是犯罪分子利用相關服務冒充大型銀行。
Meta政策明文禁止廣告包含成人裸露及性行為內容，也禁止利用欺騙或誤導方式騙取用戶金錢。不過，《路透》去年曾報導，Meta內部一度估計，詐騙及違禁商品廣告可能貢獻公司2024年約10%營收，相當於約160億美元；Meta則表示，公司持續打擊相關廣告。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) removed dozens of Facebook and Instagram ads on Monday (the 31st). The Indian government discovered that fraud groups were using ads with explicit pornographic content to lure users into downloading malicious Android apps, which then stole online banking login credentials and even transferred funds directly from accounts.

The Indian government said the ads were run on Facebook and Instagram under names such as “Night Play” and “Kyss,” and clicking them directed users to phishing sites. Authorities have recently observed a sharp rise in malicious Android apps masquerading as porn apps, which are being used to carry out financial scams.

After the Indian government issued a warning on Monday, Reuters still found at least 39 of the related ads still live, many using graphic video thumbnails to attract clicks. Reuters queried Meta and reported the ads; Meta promptly removed all of them but did not respond to requests for comment.

One of the ads directed users to a site that claimed to offer hundreds of porn videos and 24‑hour content. To watch, users had to bypass official app stores and download an installer called “Movexa.apk.”

The Indian government warned that such malicious apps can, without the user’s knowledge, access information stored on the phone, intercept one‑time passwords (OTPs) and bank PINs, and transfer money out of bank accounts.

India suffered nearly $2.4 billion in losses from online scams in 2025. As digital payments spread rapidly in the country, fraudsters are increasingly targeting Indian users. This is the second warning in weeks to large tech platforms about financial fraud. India previously asked Google to shut down hundreds of accounts on its Firebase platform after criminals used the service to impersonate major banks.

Meta’s policy explicitly bans ads that contain adult nudity or sexual activity and prohibits deceptive practices that trick users into giving money. However, Reuters reported last year that Meta internally estimated fraud and prohibited‑goods ads could have contributed about 10% of the company’s 2024 revenue—roughly $16 billion—and Meta says it continues to combat such ads.

items.title: OpenAI找到新金雞母！ChatGPT廣告一年可望進帳10億美元
items.title_en: OpenAI Finds New Money-Maker! ChatGPT Ads Could Bring in $1 Billion in a Year
paras: OpenAI周一(31日)宣布，旗下廣告業務的年化營收運行率已達10億美元。這項業務推出僅約200天便跨越重要里程碑，公司將其視為商業模式日益多元化的證明。
所謂年化營收運行率，是依目前營收速度推算未來12個月可能達到的規模，並不代表OpenAI已實際取得10億美元廣告收入。
OpenAI正為外界預期規模龐大的首次公開募股(IPO)做準備，同時面臨向投資人證明其8,520億美元估值合理性的壓力。公司表示，廣告將與企業服務、消費者訂閱及按使用量計費的應用程式介面(API)，共同構成主要營收來源。
OpenAI今年2月開始在美國測試ChatGPT廣告，相關決定雖早在市場預期之中，仍引發不小爭議。數位廣告長期是Google(GOOGL-US)與Meta(META-US)等科技巨頭的重要獲利來源，但OpenAI的主要競爭對手Anthropic曾在首支超級盃廣告中，直接嘲諷OpenAI將廣告導入聊天機器人的做法。
目前ChatGPT Ads已進入逾40個國家，OpenAI周一進一步在印度、歐洲、中東及北非推出廣告主自助投放服務。ChatGPT廣告主要向免費版及Go方案用戶顯示，這兩類用戶占平台每周10億名活躍用戶的絕大多數。
面對外界對使用體驗及隱私的疑慮，OpenAI強調，所有廣告都會清楚標示，不會影響ChatGPT生成的回答，廣告主也無法存取用戶的私人對話內容。
OpenAI表示，下一階段將把ChatGPT Ads推向更多市場，並增加廣告格式、行銷目標、購買方式及成效衡量工具，同時探索讓企業以更自然的方式在ChatGPT中與消費者互動。
paras_en: OpenAI announced on Monday (31st) that the annualized revenue run rate of its advertising business has reached $1 billion. The service, launched just about 200 days ago, has crossed a key milestone, and the company views it as proof of its increasingly diversified business model.

The so‑called annualized revenue run rate is a projection of the scale that could be achieved over the next 12 months based on current revenue velocity, and does not mean that OpenAI has actually earned $1 billion in advertising revenue yet.

OpenAI is preparing for a highly anticipated initial public offering (IPO) while also facing pressure to justify its $852 billion valuation to investors. The company said that advertising will, alongside enterprise services, consumer subscriptions, and usage‑based API billing, form its core revenue streams.

OpenAI began testing ChatGPT ads in the United States in February this year. Although the decision was expected, it sparked significant controversy. Digital advertising has long been a major profit source for tech giants such as Google (GOOGL‑US) and Meta (META‑US), but OpenAI’s main competitor Anthropic mocked the move in its first Super Bowl ad by directly ridiculing the idea of embedding ads in a chatbot.

ChatGPT Ads are now available in more than 40 countries, and on Monday OpenAI expanded self‑serve advertising for advertisers to India, Europe, the Middle East, and North Africa. The ads appear mainly to free‑tier and Go‑plan users, who make up the vast majority of the platform’s 1 billion weekly active users.

In response to concerns about user experience and privacy, OpenAI emphasized that all ads will be clearly labeled, will not affect the answers generated by ChatGPT, and that advertisers cannot access users’ private conversation content.

OpenAI said that the next phase will roll out ChatGPT Ads to more markets, add new ad formats, marketing objectives, purchasing methods, and performance measurement tools, while exploring ways for businesses to interact with consumers in a more natural manner within ChatGPT.

items.title: 油價一漲Fed更難停手！10年期美債殖利率創逾一年半新高
items.title_en: Oil Prices Rise, Making Fed Cuts Even Harder! 10-Year US Treasury Yield Hits New High Not Seen in Over a Year and a Half
paras: 美國10年期公債殖利率周一(31日)突破4.75%，創2025年1月以來最高水準。國際油價上漲加劇通膨疑慮，市場因而提高對聯準會(Fed)進一步升息的預期，帶動美債賣壓持續擴大。
美國總統川普威脅對伊朗發動更多攻擊後，主要原油期貨價格漲幅超過3%，並在美國早盤觸及盤中高點。能源成本若持續攀升，可能阻礙通膨回落，迫使Fed採取更緊縮的貨幣政策。
美債拋售潮也蔓延至其他期限，5年期美債殖利率同樣升至2025年初以來最高。投資人近期一方面擔憂美國政府債務持續增加，另一方面則評估Fed為抑制物價壓力，究竟需要以多快的速度及多大的幅度升息。
Fed主席華許上周五在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會發表演說後，短天期美債殖利率已率先大幅上揚。華許當時表示，目前金融環境並不具有限制性，使市場解讀為Fed透過升息壓制通膨的可能性正在增加。
30年期美債殖利率周一也上升5個基點，來到接近5.26%，但仍明顯低於8月中旬觸及的多年高點。美國財政部本月稍早宣布，將擴大長天期公債回購規模，以支撐債券價格並改善市場流動性，帶動30年期殖利率一度自高點回落。
此外，長天期美債也可能受惠於月底債券指數重新平衡所帶來的買盤。由於本月發行的10年至30年期公債規模高於平均水準，相關債券將於紐約時間周一下午4時納入基準指數，追蹤指數的基金可能因此被動增持，為長天期債券提供部分支撐。
paras_en: US 10-year Treasury yields broke above 4.75% on Monday (the 31st), reaching the highest level since January 2025. Rising international oil prices have heightened inflation concerns, prompting the market to increase expectations of further Fed rate hikes and fueling continued selling pressure on US Treasuries.

After President Trump threatened further attacks on Iran, major crude oil futures jumped more than 3% and hit intraday highs in the US early session. If energy costs keep climbing, it could hinder inflation’s decline and force the Fed to adopt tighter monetary policy.

The Treasury sell‑off spread to other maturities, with the 5-year yield also climbing to its highest since early 2025. Investors are simultaneously worried about the growing US government debt and assessing how quickly and how much the Fed will need to raise rates to curb price pressures.

Following Fed Chair Powell’s remarks at the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Meeting last Friday, short‑term Treasury yields surged first. Powell said the current financial environment is not restrictive, leading markets to read that the Fed’s likelihood of using rate hikes to suppress inflation is increasing.

The 30-year Treasury yield rose 5 basis points on Monday to near 5.26%, still well below the multi‑year peak hit in mid‑August. Earlier this month the US Treasury announced an expansion of long‑term bond buybacks to support prices and improve market liquidity, which helped pull the 30‑year yield back from its high.

Long‑term Treasuries may also benefit from a month‑end bond‑index rebalancing. Because the amount of 10‑ to 30‑year bonds issued this month exceeds the average, those securities will be added to the benchmark index at 4 p.m. New York time on Monday, prompting index‑tracking funds to passively increase holdings and provide some support to long‑term bonds.

items.title: 聯發科搶XPU、輝達賣整套 黃仁勳首揭AI兩強結盟盤算
items.title_en: MediaTek Pursues XPU, NVIDIA Sells Full Suite; Jensen Huang First Reveals AI Duo Alliance Plans
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)今(31)日宣布斥資35億美元認購聯發科(2454-TW)海外第一次無擔保轉換公司債(ECB)，雙方合作正式從既有邊緣AI與PC晶片，全面擴大至客製化XPU與AI Factory。輝達執行長黃仁勳與聯發科執行長蔡力行受訪時直言，未來只要聯發科拿下XPU專案，就有機會同步帶動輝達NVLink、交換器、CPU與機櫃級AI基礎建設銷售，「當聯發科贏，我們就有機會賣更多；當我們贏，聯發科也有機會賣更多」。
黃仁勳指出，輝達與聯發科原本就有深厚合作，早期雙方將NVIDIA NVLink chip-to-chip介面整合至聯發科SoC，使聯發科處理器可以直接與NVIDIA GPU連接，並催生DGX Spark等產品。接下來，雙方合作將進一步延伸至多個世代，涵蓋DGX Spark、RTX Spark，以及未來AI PC相關產品。
相較既有合作，此次更具戰略意義的部分在於AI資料中心。黃仁勳表示，聯發科在客製化XPU領域已取得相當成果，未來透過NVLink Fusion，可將聯發科設計的XPU直接接入NVIDIA完整AI Factory架構。
也就是說，聯發科未來拿下超大規模雲端業者、雲端服務供應商或AI模型開發商的客製化XPU訂單後，客戶不必再自行建置整套周邊系統，而可直接搭配NVIDIA既有的scale-up、scale-out網路、Spectrum-X交換器、CPU與機櫃級架構，大幅縮短開發時間。
黃仁勳強調，現在的AI Factory早已不只是GPU，而是一套完整系統還需要多種交換器、網路、CPU與其他晶片。他透露，目前一座AI Factory內約涉及7種不同類型的NVIDIA晶片，而XPU僅會取代其中一部分，因此即使客戶導入客製化ASIC，NVIDIA仍可透過其他基礎建設產品持續參與。
他也直言，NVIDIA並不畏懼XPU或ASIC快速崛起，因為XPU不是要進入市場，而是早就在市場裡。相較XPU屬於專用晶片，NVIDIA GPU定位為通用加速器，可涵蓋資料處理、AI訓練、後訓練與Agentic AI推論等完整工作負載。
因此，面對大型雲端業者持續投入自研ASIC，NVIDIA的策略不是封閉生態系，而是主動透過NVLink Fusion讓這些XPU更容易接入NVIDIA平台。黃仁勳直言，輝達並沒有受到威脅，反而歡迎它，只要客戶仍採用NVIDIA整套AI基礎建設，即使部分運算改用客製化XPU，NVIDIA仍能分享整體AI Factory成長商機。
蔡力行則表示，AI運算市場橫跨超大規模雲端業者自研ASIC、企業資料中心，一直到桌上型AI超級電腦，不同客戶都有不同程度的客製化需求。聯發科的XPU設計能力搭配NVIDIA NVLink Fusion，可以讓客戶更快推出差異化產品，尤其在AI快速演進下，縮短time-to-market已成為最重要的競爭力之一。
針對此次合作是否有助聯發科AI ASIC業務進一步加速，蔡力行也明確表示，當然預期會如此。不過，由於目前才開始把NVIDIA最新一代NVLink技術整合進相關機櫃與系統平台，實際效益仍需要一些時間逐步發酵。
蔡力行更透露，目前聯發科已與部分潛在客戶展開接洽，其中部分專案甚至將與NVIDIA採取共同Go-to-Market模式。此次NVIDIA直接投資聯發科，也可望進一步提升客戶對雙方合作關係的信心，讓客戶更願意採用聯發科XPU搭配NVLink Fusion的整體方案。
黃仁勳指出，這次35億美元投資也代表雙方關係已從單純技術合作，升級成更大規模的工程與商業整合，聯發科也是輝達目前最大型的合作夥伴關係之一。他也透露，自己與蔡力行已認識25年，雙方關係建立在長期信任之上，而這次合作更不是一至兩年的短期專案，而是長達十年的產品路線圖，輝達也希望透過35億美元投資，展現對聯發科與雙方合作前景的高度信心。
另一方面，蔡力行也指出，聯發科此次募資資金將用於多項用途，除了強化全球供應鏈外，也將持續加碼晶片設計、ASIC、互連IP以及先進封裝能力，藉此支援後續更大型的AI專案。
他坦言，目前聯發科最大的挑戰仍是供應鏈，包括HBM、載板等環節都存在壓力，不過台灣位處全球AI基礎建設供應鏈核心，加上未來可進一步整合NVIDIA供應鏈資源，將有助提升聯發科承接大型AI ASIC專案的能力。
黃仁勳也補充，透過此次合作，NVIDIA的networking生態系將成為聯發科供應鏈的一部分，而聯發科的XPU能力也將納入NVIDIA生態系，等於雙方彼此擴大供應鏈與產品版圖。
值得注意的是，黃仁勳此次也透露，NVIDIA下一代HBM將採用客製化HBM架構，HBM stack底部將使用NVIDIA自行設計的custom base layer，相關技術已開放給NVLink Fusion合作夥伴，包括聯發科與亞馬遜(Amazon)(AMZN-US)，未來可與客製化XPU共同整合進先進封裝。
這也顯示，聯發科與NVIDIA的合作已不只是晶片對晶片的互連，而是一路延伸至XPU、HBM、先進封裝、Networking與機櫃級AI Factory。對聯發科而言，可藉此從單純ASIC設計角色，進一步切入完整AI系統平台；對NVIDIA而言，則可在客戶自研ASIC趨勢持續升溫下，藉由NVLink Fusion把更多客製化晶片納入自身生態系，持續擴大每座AI Factory中的內容價值。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) announced today (the 31st) that it will invest $3.5 billion to subscribe to MediaTek's (2454-TW) first overseas unsecured convertible bond (ECB), formalizing a partnership that expands from existing edge AI and PC chips to custom XPU and AI Factory solutions. NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang and MediaTek CEO Cai Lixing said that whenever MediaTek wins an XPU project, it could also drive sales of NVIDIA NVLink, switches, CPUs and rack‑level AI infrastructure, adding, "When MediaTek wins, we have the chance to sell more; when we win, MediaTek also has the chance to sell more."

Huang noted that NVIDIA and MediaTek already have deep cooperation; early on the two integrated NVIDIA’s NVLink chip‑to‑chip interface into MediaTek SoCs, allowing MediaTek processors to connect directly to NVIDIA GPUs and spawning products such as DGX Spark. Going forward the collaboration will extend across multiple generations, covering DGX Spark, RTX Spark and future AI‑PC related products.

Compared with existing cooperation, the more strategic element this time lies in AI data centers. Huang said MediaTek has achieved significant results in custom XPU, and through NVLink Fusion the XPU designed by MediaTek can be plugged directly into NVIDIA’s full AI Factory architecture.

In other words, once MediaTek secures large‑scale cloud operators, cloud service providers or AI model developers for custom XPU orders, customers will no longer need to build an entire surrounding system themselves; they can simply pair the XPU with NVIDIA’s existing scale‑up, scale‑out networking, Spectrum‑X switches, CPUs and rack‑level architectures, dramatically shortening development time.

Huang emphasized that today’s AI Factory is no longer just GPUs but a complete system that requires many switches, networks, CPUs and other chips. He disclosed that a typical AI Factory involves about seven different types of NVIDIA chips, and XPU will replace only a portion of them, so even if customers adopt custom ASICs, NVIDIA can still participate through its other infrastructure products.

He also stated that NVIDIA is not afraid of the rapid rise of XPU or ASIC, because XPU is not a new market entrant—it has already been in the market. While XPU is a specialized chip, NVIDIA GPUs are positioned as general‑purpose accelerators that can handle data processing, AI training, post‑training and agentic AI inference workloads in full.

Therefore, faced with large cloud providers investing in self‑developed ASICs, NVIDIA’s strategy is not to close the ecosystem but to proactively make those XPUs easier to integrate via NVLink Fusion. Huang said NVIDIA does not feel threatened; on the contrary, it welcomes XPU, because as long as customers continue to use NVIDIA’s full AI infrastructure, even if part of the compute shifts to custom XPU, NVIDIA can still share the overall AI Factory growth opportunity.

Cai said the AI compute market spans from self‑developed ASICs of hyperscale cloud providers, to enterprise data centers, all the way to desktop AI supercomputers, and each customer has varying degrees of customization needs. MediaTek’s XPU design capability combined with NVIDIA NVLink Fusion enables customers to launch differentiated products faster, and in the rapidly evolving AI landscape, shortening time‑to‑market has become one of the most critical competitive advantages.

When asked whether the partnership will accelerate MediaTek’s AI ASIC business, Cai answered unequivocally that it will. However, because the integration of NVIDIA’s latest‑generation NVLink into relevant racks and system platforms has only just begun, the tangible benefits will take some time to mature.

Cai also revealed that MediaTek is already in talks with several potential customers, and some projects may adopt a joint go‑to‑market model with NVIDIA. NVIDIA’s direct investment in MediaTek is expected to boost customer confidence in the partnership, making them more willing to adopt MediaTek XPU together with the NVLink Fusion solution.

Huang pointed out that the $3.5 billion investment also signals that the relationship has moved beyond pure technology cooperation to a larger‑scale engineering and commercial integration, making MediaTek one of NVIDIA’s biggest partners. He added that he and Cai have known each other for 25 years, their relationship built on long‑term trust, and that this is not a one‑ or two‑year pilot but a ten‑year product roadmap; the investment demonstrates NVIDIA’s strong confidence in MediaTek and their joint future.

Cai added that the funds raised will be used for multiple purposes: strengthening the global supply chain, and further investing in chip design, ASICs, interconnect IP and advanced packaging capabilities to support larger AI projects down the line.

He admitted that MediaTek’s biggest challenge remains the supply chain, with pressure on HBM, substrates and other components. However, Taiwan sits at the core of the global AI infrastructure supply chain, and integrating NVIDIA’s supply‑chain resources will help MediaTek enhance its ability to take on large AI ASIC projects.

Huang also noted that through this cooperation, NVIDIA’s networking ecosystem will become part of MediaTek’s supply chain, and MediaTek’s XPU capability will be incorporated into NVIDIA’s ecosystem, effectively expanding both parties’ supply chains and product portfolios.

It is noteworthy that Huang disclosed NVIDIA’s next‑generation HBM will use a custom HBM architecture, with the bottom of the HBM stack employing a custom base layer designed by NVIDIA. This technology is being opened to NVLink Fusion partners, including MediaTek and Amazon (AMZN-US), and can be co‑integrated with custom XPU in advanced packaging.

This shows that the MediaTek‑NVIDIA collaboration now goes beyond chip‑to‑chip interconnect to encompass XPU, HBM, advanced packaging, networking and rack‑level AI Factory. For MediaTek, it provides a path from a pure ASIC design role to a full AI system platform; for NVIDIA, it allows more custom chips to be folded into its ecosystem via NVLink Fusion, expanding the value of each AI Factory.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉美伊交火推升油價與美債殖利率 主要指數開低
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Open Lower as US‑Iran Conflict Boosts Oil Prices and Treasury Yields
paras: 美股主要指數周一(31日)開低，美國與伊朗相隔一個月再度互相發動攻擊，帶動國際油價急升，美國原油突破每桶85美元，加劇市場對通膨及聯準會(Fed)升息的擔憂；能源成本攀升也推動10年期美債殖利率逼近2025年1月以來高點。儘管周一走弱，三大指數8月仍可望全數收漲。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數跌近280點或近0.5%，那斯達克綜合指數跌近100點或近0.4%，標普 500 指數跌0.4%，費城半導體指數漲近0.4%。台積電 ADR 漲0.7%。
美股主要指數期貨周一在交投清淡之際走低，美國與伊朗相隔約一個月再度互相發動攻擊，帶動國際油價上漲，也加深市場對能源成本與聯準會(Fed)利率政策的擔憂。
截稿前，標普500指數期貨下跌0.3%，歐洲Stoxx 600指數大致持平。英國市場因國定假日休市，美債與美元則僅小幅波動。

paras_en: U.S. stock major indices opened lower on Monday (the 31st) as the United States and Iran, a month after their last exchange of attacks, resumed hostilities, sending international oil prices sharply higher. U.S. crude broke above $85 a barrel, heightening market concerns about inflation and Federal Reserve rate hikes; rising energy costs also pushed the 10‑year Treasury yield close to its highest level since January 2025. Despite the weakness on Monday, all three major indices are still expected to finish August in positive territory.

Before the deadline, the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell nearly 280 points, about 0.5%, the Nasdaq Composite slipped almost 100 points, about 0.4%, the S&P 500 dropped 0.4%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose about 0.4%. TSMC ADR gained 0.7%.

U.S. stock index futures traded lower on Monday amid thin trading as the United States and Iran, roughly a month apart, launched another round of attacks, lifting global oil prices and deepening market worries about energy costs and Fed policy.
Before the deadline, S&P 500 futures were down 0.3% while Europe’s Stoxx 600 was broadly flat. The UK market was closed for a public holiday, and U.S. Treasuries and the dollar moved only marginally.

The renewed U.S.–Iran clash pushed Brent crude toward $91 a barrel. If oil keeps climbing, it could add to inflation pressure and make the Fed’s policy outlook more complicated. Investors are now weighing whether a September rate hike is possible, but the equity market so far appears largely unfazed by persistently high energy prices.

Fed Chair Jerome Powell’s remarks at the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Meeting last week spurred a noticeable rise in rate‑hike bets. Bloomberg’s compiled swap‑market data show traders now assign roughly a 60% probability to a Fed hike next month, up sharply from about 34% before Powell’s speech.

Powell said the current financial environment is not restrictive and described interest rates as the Fed’s “primary tool” for achieving its policy mission, but he did not explicitly back a September hike. Even as markets price in higher odds, bond investors at ABN Amro Investment Solutions and Brandywine Global Investment Management remain skeptical that the Fed will actually raise rates further.

In the currency market, the yen slipped past the 160 per dollar mark, entering a historically sensitive zone that once prompted Japanese authorities to intervene, reigniting market focus on whether the Japanese government might step in to support the currency.

On the corporate side, fast‑fashion e‑commerce firm Shein Global Holdings completed its Hong Kong IPO pricing, raising $1.7 billion and valuing the company at about $26 billion—far below its peak valuation of $100 billion. Shein’s shares plunged 17% in after‑hours dark‑pool trading.

The firm says Powell’s speech was “clearly hawkish”; although he still declined to give forward guidance, he effectively signaled further tightening. Market pricing has shifted accordingly, with CME FedWatch data showing the probability of a September hike rising to 60.4%, well above the pre‑speech level.

Morgan Stanley economist Seth Carpenter notes that Powell’s long‑term push to shrink the $7 trillion balance sheet remains significant. He expects the Fed could begin a balance‑sheet reduction of over $1.5 trillion next year, partially offsetting the need for further rate hikes.

items.title: 蘋果「老臣」又少一位？希勒卸兩大要職、退休腳步近了
items.title_en: Apple Veteran Schiller Steps Down from Two Major Roles, Retirement Looms
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)高層世代交替持續加速。在新任執行長特納斯(John Ternus)周二(1日)正式接棒前夕，橫跨賈伯斯(Steve Jobs)與庫克(Tim Cook)時代的資深高層希勒(Phil Schiller)，近日已卸下App Store及產品發表會兩大管理職務，被內部視為朝最終退休邁出的重要一步。
《彭博》引述知情人士報導，現年66歲的希勒仍將留在蘋果，保有「Apple Fellow」頭銜，並向員工表示未來將參與其他尚未公開的專案。蘋果發言人對此拒絕置評。
希勒曾長期擔任蘋果全球行銷資深副總裁，直到2020年卸任。他是蘋果過去數十年最具代表性的高層之一，不僅曾親自發表多款重要產品，也參與iPhone、iPad、iPod及多款Mac的關鍵決策，並與賈伯斯共同主導App Store的誕生。
此次異動正值蘋果權力交接的重要時刻。庫克結束15年執行長生涯後轉任執行董事長，特納斯則正式接掌公司。隨著希勒淡出核心管理職務，特納斯上任後面臨的一大挑戰，就是如何因應資深高層接連離開或退居二線。
近年蘋果已有多名重量級主管異動，包括前營運長威廉斯(Jeff Williams)、前硬體主管里奇奧(Dan Riccio)、前財務長梅斯特里(Luca Maestri)，以及環境與政府事務主管傑克森(Lisa Jackson)等人，均已卸任或轉任較小職務。此外，前法務長與Apple Pay部門主管也預計10月離職。
希勒卸下職務後，App Store將重新劃歸由資深主管庫伊(Eddy Cue)領導的服務事業部。庫伊過去曾負責App Store，直到2015年相關業務才交由希勒與行銷部門管理。此次調整也意味著，庫伊在特納斯時代的影響力將進一步擴大。
App Store日常營運則將由資深主管奧利佛(Carson Oliver)負責，並直接向庫伊報告。原先負責第三方應用程式市集及App分發工具的Thai(Ann Thai)，未來將改向奧利佛報告；Apple Arcade遊戲服務也將納入其管理範圍。
希勒掌管App Store期間，職責遠超過管理這個估計每年創造逾300億美元營收的平台。他長期負責爭議性App的上架與否決策、開發者關係，以及因應各國監管與訴訟調整App Store政策和收入分潤制度，也曾代表蘋果面對《要塞英雄》(Fortnite)開發商Epic Games的長期法律攻防。
另一方面，希勒自2020年卸下行銷主管後仍持續掌管蘋果全球活動及產品發表會業務，如今也將相關職責交給自2023年起擔任其副手的Nola Weinstein。這項交接正值蘋果9月9日舉行秋季發表會前夕，屆時預料將推出首款摺疊iPhone及新一代Apple Watch。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) senior leadership turnover is accelerating. On the eve of new CEO John Ternus officially taking the helm on Tuesday (the 1st), veteran executive Phil Schiller, who spans the Steve Jobs and Tim Cook eras, has recently relinquished his two major management posts overseeing the App Store and product launch events, a move seen internally as a key step toward his ultimate retirement.

Bloomberg, citing sources, reported that the 66‑year‑old Schiller will remain at Apple with the title of “Apple Fellow” and has told staff he will take part in other, as‑yet‑unannounced projects. Apple’s spokesperson declined to comment.

Schiller long served as senior vice president of worldwide marketing until stepping down in 2020. He has been one of Apple’s most iconic executives for decades, personally unveiling numerous flagship products, shaping key decisions for the iPhone, iPad, iPod and various Macs, and co‑leading the creation of the App Store alongside Jobs.

The reshuffle comes at a pivotal moment of power transition at Apple. After 15 years as CEO, Cook is moving to the role of executive chairman, while Ternus formally assumes the chief executive post. With Schiller stepping back from core management, Ternus inherits the challenge of navigating a wave of senior departures and semi‑retirements.

In recent years Apple has seen several heavyweight executives move on, including former COO Jeff Williams, former hardware chief Dan Riccio, former CFO Luca Maestri and environmental and government affairs head Lisa Jackson, all of whom have either left or shifted to smaller roles. Additionally, the former general counsel and head of Apple Pay are slated to depart in October.

Following Schiller’s exit, the App Store will be reassigned to the Services division led by senior executive Eddy Cue. Cue previously oversaw the App Store until 2015, when those responsibilities were transferred to Schiller and the marketing organization. The change signals an expansion of Cue’s influence in the Ternus era.

Day‑to‑day App Store operations will be handled by senior manager Carson Oliver, who will report directly to Cue. Ann Thai, who previously managed the third‑party app marketplace and distribution tools, will now report to Oliver, and Apple Arcade will also fall under his purview.

During Schiller’s tenure overseeing the App Store, his responsibilities far exceeded running a platform that generates more than $30 billion in annual revenue. He handled contentious app approvals, developer relations, and adjustments to App Store policies and revenue‑share structures in response to global regulators and lawsuits, and he represented Apple in the protracted legal battle with Epic Games over Fortnite.

Separately, after stepping down as head of marketing in 2020, Schiller continued to run Apple’s global events and product launches. Those duties are now being handed over to Nola Weinstein, who has served as his deputy since 2023. The handoff comes just before Apple’s September 9 fall event, where the company is expected to unveil its first foldable iPhone and a new generation of Apple Watch.

items.title: 蘋果「庫克時代」正式落幕！最後一封員工信吐露15年真心話
items.title_en: Apple’s “Cook Era” Officially Ends! Final Employee Letter Reveals 15 Years of Heartfelt Reflections
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)執行長庫克(Tim Cook)周一(31日)正式卸下執行長職務，結束長達15年的掌舵生涯。他在任內最後一封致全體員工信中坦言，自己將非常想念這份深愛的工作，但對於把公司交棒給新任執行長特納斯(John Ternus)感到無比安心，並相信後者有能力帶領蘋果邁向下一個階段。
庫克自2011年8月接替蘋果共同創辦人賈伯斯(Steve Jobs)出任執行長，在位期間見證Apple Watch、AirPods等產品問世，同時持續擴大iPhone、iPad與Mac產品線，帶領蘋果締造一段創紀錄的15年執行長任期。
庫克在信中表示，「今天是我擔任蘋果執行長的最後一天」，儘管早已知道這一天終將到來，但真正面對時仍感到難以置信。他感謝員工多年來的付出，並將自己的成就歸功於整個團隊，稱自己從未見過如此傑出的一群人。
回顧蘋果文化，庫克表示，他最自豪的並不是財報能夠呈現的數字，而是公司證明「文化勝過一切」。蘋果員工共同相信，他們打造的產品具有意義，也肩負讓世界變得更好的責任。正是這種信念，讓團隊能彼此激發潛能，實現賈伯斯口中在宇宙留下「一道印記」的願景。
談到卸任心情，庫克坦言，雖然自己並未離開蘋果，但正告別一個深愛的職位，「我將以現在甚至難以想像的方式想念這份工作」，但同時強調，自己對卸任決定已完全釋然。
對於接班人特納斯，庫克則給予高度評價。他表示，很少有人能像特納斯一樣理解打造「改變世界產品」所需要的一切，並形容他聰明、優秀且能力出眾，「我對他的領導再期待不過」。
庫克卸任後並不會離開蘋果，而是轉任執行董事長，未來仍將代表公司處理與全球各國政府的關係，包括美國與中國等重要市場。他也向員工表示，期待未來以新的身分繼續在Apple Park以及世界各地與大家見面。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) CEO Tim Cook formally stepped down from the chief executive role on Monday (the 31st), ending a 15‑year tenure at the helm. In his last letter to all employees, he admitted he will deeply miss the job he loves, but feels completely confident handing the company over to new CEO John Ternus, believing Ternus has the ability to lead Apple into its next phase.

Cook succeeded co‑founder Steve Jobs as CEO in August 2011. During his time in office he oversaw the launch of products such as the Apple Watch and AirPods, while continuously expanding the iPhone, iPad and Mac lines, guiding Apple through a record‑setting 15‑year run as chief executive.

In the letter Cook wrote, “Today is my last day as Apple’s CEO.” Although he had long known the day would come, facing it in reality still felt surreal. He thanked employees for years of dedication and credited his achievements to the entire team, saying he had never seen such an outstanding group of people.

Reflecting on Apple’s culture, Cook said his greatest pride isn’t the numbers on the financial statements but the proof that “culture beats everything.” Apple staff share the belief that the products they create are meaningful and carry a responsibility to make the world better. This conviction, he said, fuels the team’s ability to inspire one another and fulfill the vision Steve Jobs spoke of—leaving a “mark in the universe.”

Speaking about his feelings on stepping down, Cook confessed that although he isn’t leaving Apple, he is saying goodbye to a beloved role. “I will miss this job in ways I can’t even imagine now,” he wrote, while emphasizing that he is fully at peace with his decision to step aside.

Regarding his successor Ternus, Cook gave high praise, noting that few people understand what it takes to build “world‑changing products” as well as Ternus does. He described him as smart, excellent and exceptionally capable, adding, “I could not have higher expectations for his leadership.”

After stepping down as CEO, Cook will not leave Apple; he will become Executive Chairman, continuing to represent the company in dealings with governments worldwide, including key markets such as the United States and China. He told employees he looks forward to meeting them in his new role at Apple Park and around the globe.

items.title: 美媒：中國長鑫存儲已開始試產HBM3E 可能數周內大規模量產
items.title_en: US Media: China's ChangXin Memory Has Started Trial Production of HBM3E, May Reach Mass Production Within Weeks
paras: 美國科技媒體《The Information》週一(8月31日)報導指出，長鑫存儲(CXMT)已經啟動HBM3E記憶體的風險試產工作。該記憶體廠商目前計畫擴大產能，預計到今年底DRAM產能將達到每月35萬片晶圓，未來幾年產能也將持續提高。
目前還不清楚長鑫存儲HBM3E的具體規格，但根據JEDEC規範，HBM3E應採用1024-bit位元寬，單腳速率介於9.2Gbps至 12.4Gbps之間，大多數標準配置的目標速率為9.6Gbps。在9.6Gbps的典型配置下，HBM3E總頻寬可達1.2TB/s，
在採用 8 層堆疊、單層24Gb DRAM晶片的情況下，HBM3E單一堆疊容量為 24GB，採用12層堆疊時容量可達36GB。
考量到長鑫存儲先前已具備從風險試產快速過渡到大規模量產的能力，因此其HBM3E有可能在數週內進入大規模量產階段。
此外，長鑫存儲在晶圓廠無塵室建造速度方面擁有明顯優勢，建造一座晶圓廠無塵室僅需時12個月，其他廠商通常需​​要兩年。
paras_en: The U.S. technology outlet The Information reported on Monday (August 31) that ChangXin Memory (CXMT) has begun risk‑run trial production of its HBM3E memory. The company is planning to expand capacity and expects its DRAM output to reach 350,000 wafers per month by the end of this year, with further increases in the coming years.

Specific details of CXMT’s HBM3E are not yet disclosed, but according to JEDEC specifications the HBM3E should use a 1024‑bit interface with per‑pin data rates ranging from 9.2 Gbps to 12.4 Gbps, most standard configurations targeting 9.6 Gbps. At the typical 9.6 Gbps configuration, the total bandwidth of HBM3E can reach 1.2 TB/s.
With an 8‑stack configuration using 24‑Gb DRAM dies per layer, a single HBM3E stack provides 24 GB of capacity; a 12‑stack configuration can reach 36 GB per stack.
Given CXMT’s proven ability to move quickly from risk‑run trials to large‑scale production, its HBM3E could enter mass production within a few weeks.
CXMT also enjoys a clear advantage in clean‑room construction speed, being able to build a wafer‑fab cleanroom in just 12 months, whereas other manufacturers typically require about two years.
